It highlights the importance of accurate annotation of rpoB mutations for effective communication and diagnosis of rifampicin resistance in mycobacteria.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed the rpoB gene sequences of various mycobacterial species and evaluated the impact of different numbering systems on the interpretation of rifampicin resistance mutations.

full_output.methodology: The study utilized a neutropenic mouse thigh infection model to assess the pharmacodynamic effects of ceftolozane and tazobactam combinations, analyzing dose-response relationships and pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic indices.

full_output.paper_title: rRNA Operon Copy Number Can Explain the Distinct Epidemiology of Hospital-Associated Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus.

full_output.paper_title: Staphylococcus capitis isolated from prosthetic joint infections.

full_output.paper_title: Glutathione-mediated antioxidant response and aerobic metabolism: two crucial factors involved in determining the multi-drug resistance of high-risk neuroblastoma.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies ARNT, Ezrin, ABCB6, and BCRP1 as over-expressed genes in etoposide-resistant HTLA-Chr cells, contributing to multi-drug resistance through enhanced antioxidant response and aerobic metabolism.

full_output.paper_title: Crystal structure and DNA binding activity of a PadR family transcription regulator from hypervirulent Clostridium difficile R20291.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes cdPadR1, a PadR-s2 subfamily transcription regulator from Clostridium difficile R20291, which binds its own promoter and other promoter regions, suggesting a role in gene regulatory networks.
full_output.methodology: Structural analysis, EMSA, and motif analysis were used to investigate cdPadR1's DNA binding properties and regulatory roles.

full_output.paper_title: Pseudomonas mendocina native valve infective endocarditis: a case report.
full_output.key_findings: The case report describes a rare instance of native valve infective endocarditis caused by Pseudomonas mendocina, highlighting its susceptibility to third-generation cephalosporins and distinguishing it from Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
full_output.methodology: Case report and literature review.

full_output.paper_title: Ciprofloxacin triggered glutamate production by Corynebacterium glutamicum.
full_output.key_findings: Ciprofloxacin triggered glutamate production in Corynebacterium glutamicum, and this effect was not dependent on the presence of the glutamate exporter gene yggB.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic analysis, enzyme activity assays, and amino acid quantification.

full_output.paper_title: Multidrug resistance operon emrAB contributes for chromate and ampicillin co-resistance in a Staphylococcus strain isolated from refinery polluted river bank.

full_output.key_findings: The emrAB operon in Staphylococcus aureus LZ-01 confers co-resistance to chromate and ampicillin, as evidenced by gene knockout and complementation experiments showing reduced resistance in mutants.
full_output.methodology: RNA-seq, qPCR, gene knockout, and complementation experiments were used to validate the role of emrAB in co-resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Intrinsic Resistance to 5-Fluorouracil in a Brain Metastatic Variant of Human Breast Cancer Cell Line, MDA-MB-231BR.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified BCL2A1 as a key contributor to intrinsic 5-FU resistance in MDA-MB-231BR, a brain metastatic variant of human breast cancer cells. Overexpression of BCL2A1 conferred 5-FU resistance, while its knockdown sensitized the cells to 5-FU.
full_output.methodology: RNA sequencing, qRT-PCR, Western blot, ELISA, transfection, and siRNA experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Antibacterial, cytotoxic and genotoxic activity of nitrogenated and haloid derivatives of C(50)-C(60) and C(70)-C(120) polyprenol homologs.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified quaternary polyprenyl ammonium salt derivatives (GAS and MAS) as having higher antibacterial activity against E. coli and S. aureus, as well as cytotoxic activity against A549 and HepG2 cells. MAS was found to induce DNA damage in A549 and HepG2 cells, suggesting apoptosis as the mechanism of cell death.
full_output.methodology: The study used Oxford cup assays, broth dilution method, time-killing curves, MTT assay, and comet assay to evaluate the antibacterial, cytotoxic, and genotoxic activities of polyprenol derivatives.

full_output.paper_title: Defensins: The Case for Their Use against Mycobacterial Infections.
full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses the role of defensins in combating mycobacterial infections and identifies the mprF gene as a contributor to defensin resistance in various pathogens.
full_output.methodology: Review of literature and experimental data on defensins and their role in antimicrobial resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Genetic Dissection of the Type VI Secretion System in Acinetobacter and Identification of a Novel Peptidoglycan Hydrolase, TagX, Required for Its Biogenesis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified TagX, a novel peptidoglycan hydrolase, as essential for the biogenesis of the type VI secretion system (T6SS) in Acinetobacter species. TagX was shown to possess l,d-endopeptidase activity and is required for the extracellular export of Hcp.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic and genetic analyses, mutational studies, and functional characterization of T6SS components.

full_output.key_findings: The study shows that Candida albicans biofilm matrix components, particularly β-1,3-glucan, enhance Staphylococcus aureus tolerance to vancomycin and other antibiotics by impairing drug diffusion and forming a protective barrier.
full_output.methodology: The study used biofilm formation, susceptibility testing, enzymatic treatments, and microscopic analyses to investigate the role of C. albicans matrix components in S. aureus resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Potential Relationship between Phenotypic and Molecular Characteristics in Revealing Livestock-Associated Staphylococcus aureus in Chinese Humans without Occupational Livestock Contact.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various immune evasion cluster (IEC) genes (scn, chp, sak, sea, sep) in Staphylococcus aureus isolates, highlighting their association with livestock-associated strains and potential implications for human transmission.
full_output.methodology: PCR and MLST for molecular characterization, antimicrobial susceptibility testing using Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion.

full_output.paper_title: Multilevel selection of bcrABDR-mediated bacitracin resistance in Enterococcus faecalis from chicken farms.

bcrABDR.encodes: bacitracin resistance transporter and regulatory protein

full_output.key_findings: The study identified the bacitracin resistance locus bcrABDR in Enterococcus faecalis isolates from chicken farms, highlighting its prevalence and association with multi-drug resistance. The locus was found to be present in various plasmids and was linked to resistance against bacitracin, erythromycin, tetracycline, streptomycin, florfenicol, and kanamycin.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, PFGE, MLST, conjugation experiments, and plasmid characterization.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic Epidemiology of Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus in a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified various aminoglycoside and macrolide resistance genes in MRSA strains, including aadE, aphA-3, aadD, spc, ermA, mphC, msrA, and ermC, which contribute to resistance against specific antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Genomic analysis of MRSA isolates from a NICU to identify resistance and virulence genes.

full_output.paper_title: Nosocomial outbreak of KPC-2- and NDM-1-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae in a neonatal ward: a retrospective study.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified KPC-2 and NDM-1 carbapenemases as the primary resistance mechanisms in Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates during an outbreak in a neonatal ward. These genes conferred resistance to carbapenems and other beta-lactam antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: PCR, agar dilution method, and MLST were used to identify resistance genes, determine antimicrobial susceptibility, and assess genetic relatedness.

full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the Abbott RealTime MTB and RealTime MTB INH/RIF assays for detecting Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex and resistance markers. The assays identified resistance markers for isoniazid (INH) and rifampin (RIF) through specific gene mutations.
full_output.methodology: Real-time PCR and automated analysis were used to detect Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex and resistance markers in clinical specimens.

full_output.paper_title: Occurrence and characteristics of extended-spectrum β-lactamases producing Escherichia coli in foods of animal origin and human clinical samples in Chhattisgarh, India.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of bla TEM and bla CTX-M genes in Escherichia coli isolates from various sources including chicken meat, chevon meat, raw milk, and human clinical samples, indicating the presence of extended-spectrum β-lactamase-producing strains.
full_output.methodology: Multiplex-polymerase chain reaction was used to detect the presence of bla TEM, bla SHV, and bla CTX-M genes in E. coli isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Dynamics of a Class 1 Integron Located on Plasmid or Chromosome in Two Aeromonas spp. Strains.

dfrA12.validation_method: PCR amplification and sequencing of integron variable regions

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the functionality and dynamics of two Class 1 integrons carrying the cassette arrangement dfrA12-orfF-aadA2 in Aeromonas dhakensis 3430-1 and A. hydrophila 6479, demonstrating that the plasmid-localized integron responds differently to streptomycin compared to the chromosomal one.
full_output.methodology: PCR amplification, sequencing, and analysis of integron variable regions and integration intermediaries.

full_output.paper_title: Development of a one-pot assay for screening and identification of Mur pathway inhibitors in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
full_output.key_findings: The study developed a one-pot assay for the reconstruction of the Mtb Mur pathway, enabling the screening of inhibitors targeting multiple enzymes in the pathway. Compounds 3 and 4 showed significant inhibition of the Mur pathway, with compound 4 demonstrating notable inhibition of MurE and MurF. D-Cycloserine was identified as an inhibitor of the Mur pathway, particularly targeting MurF.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized biochemical assays, purification of Mur enzymes, and ESI-MS analysis to validate the one-pot assay and assess inhibitor efficacy.

full_output.methodology: The study analyzed 8,757 GBS isolates for antibiotic susceptibility and characterized FQ-resistant isolates through molecular techniques including PCR and sequencing of the QRDR region of gyrA and parC genes.

full_output.paper_title: Fluorescent Trimethoprim Conjugate Probes To Assess Drug Accumulation in Wild Type and Mutant Escherichia coli.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified that the TolC efflux pump component plays a critical role in the efflux of trimethoprim (TMP) probes, affecting their accumulation in E. coli. The restoration of antimicrobial activity against a TolC-deficient mutant strain highlights the importance of TolC in drug resistance mechanisms.
full_output.methodology: The study used fluorescence-based assays, flow cytometry, and LC-MS/MS to measure the accumulation of TMP probes in E. coli strains, including wild type and TolC-deficient mutants.

full_output.paper_title: Altered stoichiometry Escherichia coli Cascade complexes with shortened CRISPR RNA spacers are capable of interference and primed adaptation.
full_output.key_findings: The study shows that E. coli Cascade complexes with shortened CRISPR RNA spacers can still mediate CRISPR interference and primed adaptation, demonstrating that the stoichiometry of the Cascade complex is influenced by the length of the crRNA spacer.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized genetic engineering, northern blotting, CRISPR interference and adaptation assays, and mass spectrometry to investigate the effects of altered crRNA spacer lengths on Cascade complex functionality.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of novel Staphylococcus aureus lytic phage and defining their combinatorial virulence using the OmniLog® system.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies seven novel polyvalent S. aureus phages that exhibit broad lytic activity against 70-91% of clinical isolates, including MRSA and MSSA. These phages are specific to S. aureus and S. hyicus, and their efficacy is influenced by cell wall teichoic acid modifications.
full_output.methodology: The study used efficiency of plating (EOP) assays, electron microscopy, and PFGE to analyze phage characteristics and their interactions with S. aureus isolates.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified various bacterial species in the apical root canals of teeth with apical periodontitis and evaluated their antibiotic susceptibility. Key findings include the detection of Prophyromonas endodontalis, Bacteroides, Dialister invisus, Fusobacterium nucleatum, Treponema denticola, Enterococcus faecalis, Peptostreptococcus, Olsenella uli, and Veillonella, with most anaerobic isolates showing sensitivity to ampicillin/sulbactam, amoxicillin/clavulanate, cefoxitin, and clindamycin.
full_output.methodology: Selective media plating, biochemical tests, and matrix-assisted laser desorption ionization-time of flight mass spectrometry were used for bacterial species determination, while disk diffusion and automated systems were employed for antibiotic susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Binding Mode of Macrocyclic Lactones on Cel-Pgp-1
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the binding mechanisms of macrocyclic lactones, including avermectins and milbemycins, to the Cel-Pgp-1 transporter, highlighting the roles of specific structural features such as the macrocyclic ring, benzofurane, spiroketal, and disaccharide moieties in determining their binding orientations and affinities.
full_output.methodology: Molecular docking simulations and analysis of binding interactions with Cel-Pgp-1 were performed.

full_output.paper_title: IncHI2 Plasmids Are Predominant in Antibiotic-Resistant Salmonella Isolates.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified IncHI2 plasmids as the main contributors to antibiotic resistance in Salmonella, with key resistance genes including aac(6')-Ib-cr, bla OXA-1, bla TEM-1, bla CMY-2, and qnrA.
full_output.methodology: PCR amplification, plasmid curing, plasmid sequencing, and replicon typing were used to identify and characterize antibiotic resistance genes and plasmids.

full_output.paper_title: The Spl Serine Proteases Modulate Staphylococcus aureus Protein Production and Virulence in a Rabbit Model of Pneumonia.
full_output.key_findings: The study reveals that the Spl proteases, specifically SplA, play a role in modulating S. aureus virulence by cleaving mucin 16, a human cell surface protein, and altering the abundance of secreted and surface proteins. The spl mutant exhibited a localized pneumonia phenotype in a rabbit model, suggesting that the Spl proteases contribute to the dissemination of lung damage.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized a rabbit pneumonia model, proteomic analyses, and biochemical assays to investigate the role of Spl proteases in S. aureus virulence.

full_output.paper_title: A High-Throughput Assay for Developing Inhibitors of PhoP, a Virulence Factor of Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
full_output.key_findings: The study developed a FRET-based high-throughput screening assay to identify PhoP inhibitors that disrupt PhoP-DNA binding, which is crucial for Mycobacterium tuberculosis virulence. Three PhoP inhibitors were identified that directly bind to PhoP and inhibit its DNA-binding activity.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized a FRET-based assay, site-directed mutagenesis, protein purification, and high-throughput screening to identify PhoP inhibitors.

full_output.key_findings: The study reports the carriage of blaNDM-1 and blaKPC-2 in Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates from a tertiary referral hospital in northeast India, highlighting the presence of multidrug-resistant strains.
full_output.methodology: Detection of carbapenemase production and analysis of plasmid types.

full_output.paper_title: Discovery of MRSA active antibiotics using primary sequence from the human microbiome.

full_output.paper_title: Diversity of plasmids and Tn1546-type transposons among VanA Enterococcus faecium in Poland.

full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, MLST, MLVA, PFGE, and hybridization analyses were used to characterize the genetic elements and resistance mechanisms.

full_output.key_findings: The study elucidates the structural basis of the interaction between Ricin A chain (RTA) and the C-terminal peptide of the ribosomal stalk protein P2, highlighting the importance of hydrophobic and electrostatic interactions in this binding process.
full_output.methodology: Structural biology techniques including X-ray crystallography, GST pull-down assays, and isothermal titration calorimetry were employed to investigate the interaction between RTA and P2.

full_output.paper_title: Toxigenic Vibrio cholerae O1 in vegetables and fish raised in wastewater irrigated fields and stabilization ponds during a non-cholera outbreak period in Morogoro, Tanzania: an environmental health study.
full_output.key_findings: Two isolates of V. cholerae O1 were identified, carrying the ctx, tcpA, and hlyA virulence genes. These isolates showed resistance to ampicillin, amoxicillin, and tetracycline, but were susceptible to gentamicin, chloramphenicol, and ciprofloxacin.

full_output.paper_title: Validation of the mutant selection window hypothesis with fosfomycin against Escherichia coli and Pseudomonas aeruginosa: an in vitro and in vivo comparative study.
full_output.key_findings: The study validated the mutant selection window (MSW) hypothesis with fosfomycin against E. coli and P. aeruginosa, demonstrating that resistance emerged under certain antibiotic concentrations but not others, highlighting the importance of antibiotic dosing strategies to prevent resistance development.
full_output.methodology: The study used in vitro time-kill assays and an in vivo tissue-cage infection model to assess fosfomycin's effectiveness and resistance development in E. coli and P. aeruginosa.

full_output.paper_title: Antibacterial synergy between rosmarinic acid and antibiotics against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.
full_output.key_findings: Rosmarinic acid (RA) exhibited synergistic effects with antibiotics against Staphylococcus aureus and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA). RA significantly suppressed the expression of MSCRAMM surface proteins, potentially contributing to its antibacterial activity.
full_output.methodology: Antibacterial activity was assessed using agar well diffusion and broth dilution methods. Synergism was evaluated via broth checkerboard and time-kill assays.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies two distinct mechanisms of pyrazinamide resistance: (1) missense mutations in the aspartate decarboxylase panD, which prevent pyrazinoic acid (POA)-mediated coenzyme A (CoA) depletion, and (2) loss-of-function mutations in the polyketide synthases mas and ppsA-E, which affect the synthesis of the virulence factor phthiocerol dimycocerosate (PDIM).

full_output.paper_title: High efficacy of gemifloxacin-containing therapy in Helicobacter Pylori eradication: A pilot empirical second-line rescue therapy.
full_output.key_findings: Gemifloxacin-containing quadruple therapy showed high efficacy in eradicating Helicobacter pylori, achieving a 91.4% per-protocol eradication rate, making it a potential second-line treatment option.
full_output.methodology: Prospective pilot study evaluating the efficacy of gemifloxacin-containing therapy in H. pylori eradication through 13C-urea breath test.

full_output.paper_title: Multiple roles for a novel RND-type efflux system in Acinetobacter baumannii AB5075.

arpA.encodes: periplasmic membrane fusion component of a resistance–nodulation–cell division (RND)–type efflux system
arpA.validation_method: mutant analysis showing increased susceptibility to aminoglycosides

arpB.encodes: inner membrane transporter of RND-type efflux systems
arpB.validation_method: mutant analysis showing increased susceptibility to aminoglycosides

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the RND-type efflux system genes arpA and arpB as critical for maintaining colony opacity phase variation in Acinetobacter baumannii AB5075 and shows that their disruption leads to increased susceptibility to aminoglycosides.
full_output.methodology: Transposon mutagenesis, mutant analysis, and susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Blue light treatment of Pseudomonas aeruginosa: Strong bactericidal activity, synergism with antibiotics and inactivation of virulence factors.
full_output.key_findings: Blue light treatment (BLT) effectively reduces the viability of Pseudomonas aeruginosa, inactivates virulence factors such as pyocyanin, elastases, and proteases, and increases susceptibility to antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Experiments involving blue light irradiation, analysis of virulence factors, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were conducted.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies that 1,2,4-triazolidine-3-thiones (T-3-Ts) exhibit specific activity against Acinetobacter baumannii by targeting the long-chain fatty acid (LCFA) elongation pathway, which is absent in other common nosocomial pathogens.
full_output.methodology: The study used susceptibility testing, time-killing assays, transmission electron microscopy, and mass spectrometry to investigate the mechanism of action of T-3-Ts against A. baumannii.

full_output.paper_title: Multidrug Resistance of Acinetobacter Baumannii in Ladoke Akintola University Teaching Hospital, Osogbo, Nigeria.

blaOXA.evidence_note: The paper states that blaOXA was present in two isolates and that the isolates showed resistance to ceftazidime and ceftriaxone.

blaTEM.evidence_note: The paper states that blaTEM was detected in 45.5% of isolates and that the isolates showed 90.9% resistance to ceftazidime and ceftriaxone.

blaCTX-M.evidence_note: The paper states that blaCTX-M was detected in 45.5% of isolates and that the isolates showed 90.9% resistance to ceftriaxone and ceftazidime.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified blaOXA, blaTEM, and blaCTX-M genes in Acinetobacter baumannii isolates, contributing to multidrug resistance against several antibiotics, except colistin.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of extended-spectrum beta-lactamase genes and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Klebsiella phages representing a novel clade of viruses with an unknown DNA modification and biotechnologically interesting enzymes.

YP_007348891.mechanism: regulate phage DNA resistance towards host restriction endonucleases
YP_007348891.validation_method: in silico analysis and comparison with other phages
YP_007348891.evidence_note: The two interesting genes found in KP27 genome (Fig. 1), located in positions 146,039–146,557 (173 aa) and 155,517–156,158 (213 aa), were recognized as putative homing endonuclease genes (YP_007348875 and YP_007348891).

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies two putative homing endonuclease genes (YP_007348875 and YP_007348891) in the KP27 phage, suggesting a novel mechanism for DNA modification and resistance to restriction digestion, contributing to a broader host range compared to KP15.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, in silico analysis, and comparative genomics.

full_output.paper_title: Global Escherichia coli Sequence Type 131 Clade with bla(CTX-M-27) Gene.

bla(CTX-M-27).validation_method: whole-genome sequencing and comparative genomic analysis

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a distinct clade of Escherichia coli ST131 carrying the bla(CTX-M-27) gene, which contributes significantly to the global spread of extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL)-producing E. coli, particularly in Japan and other countries.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and comparative genomic analysis were used to characterize the genetic features of the C1-M27 clade.

full_output.paper_title: The cytochrome bd-I respiratory oxidase augments survival of multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli during infection.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies cydAB and hmp as crucial genes for nitric oxide resistance in multidrug-resistant E. coli, enhancing survival during infection.
full_output.methodology: Mutant analysis and complementation experiments were conducted to evaluate the role of cydAB and hmp in nitric oxide resistance.

full_output.paper_title: Factors essential for L,D-transpeptidase-mediated peptidoglycan cross-linking and β-lactam resistance in Escherichia coli.

ycbB.mechanism: bypass of the D,D-transpeptidase activity of PBPs
ycbB.validation_method: plasmid-based expression and disk diffusion assay
ycbB.evidence_note: YcbB-mediated β-lactam resistance was shown through plasmid-based expression and disk diffusion assay.

full_output.key_findings: The study shows that the L,D-transpeptidase YcbB can bypass the D,D-transpeptidase activity of penicillin-binding proteins (PBPs) in E. coli, leading to broad-spectrum β-lactam resistance. This resistance requires the overproduction of (p)ppGpp and a chromosomal mutation.
full_output.methodology: Plasmid construction, mutagenesis, disk diffusion assays, and mass spectrometry were used to analyze the role of YcbB in β-lactam resistance.

dhfr.notes: Mutation in DHFR gene associated with trimethoprim resistance

full_output.paper_title: In Vivo Effects of Pichia Pastoris-Expressed Antimicrobial Peptide Hepcidin on the Community Composition and Metabolism Gut Microbiota of Rats.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigated the effects of Pichia pastoris-expressed hepcidin (PC-hepc) on the gut microbiota of rats. It found that high doses of PC-hepc caused intestinal inflammation and altered the gut microbiota composition in female rats, while lower doses had less pronounced effects. Additionally, PC-hepc was digested in simulated intestinal fluid but not in simulated gastric fluid.
full_output.methodology: The study used subchronic toxicity testing, 16S rRNA sequencing, and in vitro antimicrobial assays to evaluate the effects of PC-hepc on rat gut microbiota and health.

full_output.paper_title: Comparison of antimicrobial resistance patterns of ESBL and non ESBL bacterial isolates among patients with secondary peritonitis at Bugando Medical Centre, Mwanza - Tanzania.
full_output.key_findings: The study found a high prevalence of ESBL-producing bacteria among patients with secondary peritonitis, with ESBL isolates showing increased resistance to trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole and ciprofloxacin compared to non-ESBL isolates.
full_output.methodology: Cross-sectional study involving 97 patients with secondary peritonitis, including bacterial isolation, identification, and susceptibility testing using disc diffusion method.

full_output.paper_title: Characteristic of Enterococcus faecium clinical isolates with quinupristin/dalfopristin resistance in China.

msrC.evidence_note: The paper states that msrC was found in 8 of 9 Q/D-resistant E. faecium isolates and that the combinations of Q/D resistance determinants were ermB - msrC (7 isolates) and ermB - msrC - vatE (one isolate).

full_output.key_findings: The study reports the first case of quinupristin/dalfopristin (Q/D)-resistant Enterococcus faecium clinical isolates in China, identifying the genes ermB, msrC, and vatE as responsible for Q/D resistance.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing were used to identify Q/D resistance mechanisms in E. faecium isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Bis(N-amidinohydrazones) and N-(amidino)-N'-aryl-bishydrazones: New classes of antibacterial/antifungal agents.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified bis(N-amidinohydrazones) and N-(amidino)-N'-aryl-bishydrazones as new classes of antibacterial and antifungal agents with broad-spectrum activity against various bacterial and fungal strains. These compounds showed low potential for resistance development and induced ROS production in Candida albicans.
full_output.methodology: The compounds were synthesized and evaluated for antibacterial and antifungal activities using MIC assays, resistance selection experiments, ROS induction measurements, and cytotoxicity assessments.

full_output.paper_title: Click chemistry improved wet adhesion strength of mussel-inspired citrate-based antimicrobial bioadhesives.
full_output.key_findings: The study introduces a novel approach using click chemistry to enhance the wet adhesion strength and mechanical properties of mussel-inspired citrate-based bioadhesives, while maintaining antimicrobial properties.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the synthesis and characterization of clickable iCs, crosslinking techniques, and evaluation of mechanical and antimicrobial properties.

full_output.paper_title: Single-molecule imaging reveals modulation of cell wall synthesis dynamics in live bacterial cells.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigates the dynamics of penicillin-binding proteins (PBPs) involved in cell wall synthesis using single-molecule imaging techniques. It shows that PBP1A and PBP1B exhibit different diffusion constants and that their movement is influenced by enzymatic activity and interactions with other PBPs. Additionally, the outer membrane lipoprotein LpoA regulates PBP1A dynamics.
full_output.methodology: Single-molecule tracking and total internal reflection fluorescence (TIRF) microscopy were used to analyze the diffusion and behavior of PBP1A and PBP1B in live E. coli cells.

full_output.paper_title: Extract from Maize (Zea mays L.): Antibacterial Activity of DIMBOA and Its Derivatives against Ralstonia solanacearum.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified DIMBOA and its derivatives (BOA, CDHB, MBT) as having antibacterial activity against Ralstonia solanacearum, with MBT showing the strongest activity.
full_output.methodology: The antibacterial activity of DIMBOA and its derivatives was evaluated using disk diffusion, MIC, MBC, growth curve, biofilm formation, and swarming motility assays.

full_output.paper_title: Neonatal bloodstream infections in a Ghanaian Tertiary Hospital: Are the current antibiotic recommendations adequate?
full_output.key_findings: The study highlights low antibiotic susceptibility coverage for organisms causing neonatal bloodstream infections in Ghana, emphasizing the need for updated local antibiotic guidelines.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective review of neonatal blood cultures and susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Pharmacogenomic implications of the evolutionary history of infectious diseases in Africa.

ACKR1.mechanism: Confers resistance to P. vivax by abrogating DARC surface expression on red blood cells
ACKR1.evidence_note: Mutations reported in this review paper are sourced from cited studies. Original experimental data is in the referenced publications.

CCR5.mechanism: Delta 32 deletion results in non-functional receptor, conferring resistance to HIV-1
CCR5.evidence_note: Mutations reported in this review paper are sourced from cited studies. Original experimental data is in the referenced publications.

APOL1.mechanism: Variants evade serum resistance-associated inactivation, restoring protection from HAT
APOL1.evidence_note: Mutations reported in this review paper are sourced from cited studies. Original experimental data is in the referenced publications.

full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses various genetic variants and their roles in resistance to infectious diseases in Africa, including the Duffy antigen receptor for chemokines (ACKR1) conferring resistance to P. vivax, the sickle cell trait (HBB) providing protection against malaria, G6PD deficiency offering some malaria protection, the CCR5 delta 32 mutation conferring HIV-1 resistance, and APOL1 variants protecting against HAT.
full_output.methodology: Literature review and genetic variant analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Structural Characteristics of TA Proteins from Pathogenic Bacteria
full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses various type II TA systems in pathogenic bacteria, focusing on their structural characteristics and functional roles.
full_output.methodology: The paper reviews structural data of TA proteins from various pathogenic bacteria, analyzing their oligomeric states, Pfam annotations, and PDB IDs.

rmpA.mechanism: confers resistance through regulation of capsule synthesis

full_output.key_findings: The study identified rmpA and aerobactin genes as being strongly associated with the hypermucoviscosity (HV) phenotype in Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates from ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP) patients. These genes were more prevalent in HV-positive strains and correlated with increased virulence and mortality.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of K. pneumoniae isolates from VAP patients, including PCR for gene detection, MLST, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Mechanisms of first-line antimicrobial resistance in multi-drug and extensively drug resistant strains of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.

rpoB.mechanism: Mutations in the rpoB gene confer resistance to rifampicin (RIF)

katG.mechanism: Mutations in the katG gene confer resistance to isoniazid (INH)

pncA.mechanism: Mutations in the pncA gene confer resistance to pyrazinamide (PZA)

embB.mechanism: Mutations in the embB gene confer resistance to ethambutol (EMB)

rpoB.notes: Multiple mutations in rpoB were associated with RIF resistance

full_output.paper_title: Bacillus subtilis 5'-nucleotidases with various functions and substrate specificities.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified YcsE and YktC as major 5'-nucleotidases in Bacillus subtilis, with YktC also showing inositol monophosphatase activity and involvement in resistance to oxidative stress caused by diamide.
full_output.methodology: Expression of genes in E. coli, phosphatase assays, and growth experiments under oxidative stress conditions.

full_output.paper_title: Quantitative proteome analysis of Chlamydia trachomatis growth forms
full_output.key_findings: The study identified TrpA and TrpB as the most abundant proteins in the IFN-γ induced ARB form, indicating their importance in the persistence phenotype of Chlamydia trachomatis.
full_output.methodology: LC-MS/MS-based quantitative proteomics analysis of Chlamydia trachomatis growth forms.

full_output.paper_title: Diminazene aceturate: an antibacterial agent for Shiga-toxin-producing Escherichia coli O157:H7.
full_output.key_findings: The study investigates the antibacterial effects of diminazene aceturate (DA) against Shiga-toxin-producing Escherichia coli O157:H7, showing that DA effectively suppresses bacterial growth and induces reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, leading to bacterial death.
full_output.methodology: The study used bacterial growth assays, ROS detection, and protease activity tests to evaluate the effects of DA on E. coli O157:H7.

full_output.paper_title: SpyB, a Small Heme-Binding Protein, Affects the Composition of the Cell Wall in Streptococcus pyogenes.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies SpyB as a heme-binding protein that affects the composition of the cell wall in Streptococcus pyogenes, leading to altered carbohydrate structures and increased bacterial aggregation, along with reduced sensitivity to β-lactams and peptidoglycan hydrolase PlyC.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized genetic manipulation, biochemical assays, and structural analyses to investigate the function of SpyB in Streptococcus pyogenes.

full_output.paper_title: First Report of Complete Sequence of a bla(NDM-13)-Harboring Plasmid from an Escherichia coli ST5138 Clinical Isolate.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the first plasmid-encoded blaNDM-13 and its complete sequence in a carbapenem-resistant E. coli ST5138 isolate, highlighting its similarity to the blaNDM-1-harboring plasmid pNDM-HN380.
full_output.methodology: Sequencing of the plasmid and verification of its transferability via conjugation.

full_output.paper_title: Benzoate- and Salicylate-Tolerant Strains of Escherichia coli K-12 Lose Antibiotic Resistance during Laboratory Evolution.

gadX.notes: The IS5 insertion in the promoter region of gadX leads to increased expression of the gene, contributing to acid resistance.

full_output.key_findings: Benzoate- and salicylate-tolerant strains of Escherichia coli K-12 lose antibiotic resistance during laboratory evolution, with mutations in multidrug resistance (MDR) genes and regulators such as marRAB, rob, cpxA, emrA, emrY, mdtA, mdtEF, acrAB, and tolC contributing to reduced resistance to chloramphenicol and tetracycline.
full_output.methodology: Genome resequencing and mutation analysis using the breseq pipeline, along with MIC assays and growth curve experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Extended-Spectrum-Beta-Lactamase- and Plasmid-Encoded Cephamycinase-Producing Enterobacteria in the Broiler Hatchery as a Potential Mode of Pseudo-Vertical Transmission.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several beta-lactamase genes, including TEM-1, TEM-52, CTX-M1, CTX-M15, CMY-2, SHV-1, and SHV-2, which confer resistance to various beta-lactam antibiotics in ESBL-/pAmpC-producing enterobacteria isolated from broiler parent flocks and hatchery environments.
full_output.methodology: The study used disk diffusion tests, molecular analyses, and PFGE to identify and characterize beta-lactamase genes in ESBL-/pAmpC-producing enterobacteria.

full_output.paper_title: Informing Antibiotic Treatment Decisions: Evaluating Rapid Molecular Diagnostics To Identify Susceptibility and Resistance to Carbapenems against Acinetobacter spp. in PRIMERS III.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates rapid molecular diagnostics to identify carbapenem resistance in Acinetobacter spp., highlighting the presence of bla OXA-23, bla OXA-24/40, and bla OXA-58 genes as key contributors to carbapenem resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized PCR/ESI-MS and molecular beacons to detect carbapenemase genes in Acinetobacter spp. isolates.

blaCTX-M-44.notes: Mutations in blaCTX-M-44 are related to the catalytic mechanism of aztreonam hydrolysis

full_output.paper_title: Pharmacodynamics of Aerosolized Fosfomycin and Amikacin against Resistant Clinical Isolates of Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Klebsiella pneumoniae in a Hollow-Fiber Infection Model: Experimental Basis for Combination Therapy.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the pharmacodynamics of aerosolized fosfomycin and amikacin against resistant clinical isolates of Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Klebsiella pneumoniae, demonstrating that the combination therapy was effective in bacterial killing and suppressing the emergence of resistant strains.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized a hollow-fiber infection model to assess the antibacterial effects of amikacin and fosfomycin, both individually and in combination, against clinical isolates of P. aeruginosa and K. pneumoniae.

full_output.paper_title: Dual-Reporter Mycobacteriophages (Φ2DRMs) Reveal Preexisting Mycobacterium tuberculosis Persistent Cells in Human Sputum.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies genes involved in stress response and persistence in Mycobacterium tuberculosis, utilizing dual-reporter mycobacteriophages to characterize persister cells.
full_output.methodology: Use of dual-reporter mycobacteriophages and fluorescent reporter assays to analyze gene expression in persister cells.

full_output.paper_title: Antibody-Based Therapy for Enterococcal Catheter-Associated Urinary Tract Infections.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies EbpA as a critical adhesin for Enterococcus faecalis in catheter-associated urinary tract infections (CAUTI) and demonstrates that antibodies targeting the N-terminal domain of EbpA (EbpA NTD) can prevent and treat CAUTI in a murine model.
full_output.methodology: Passive immunization with antisera against EbpA NTD, bacterial titration, and ELISA for EbpA expression.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of Residues in the Lipopolysaccharide ABC Transporter That Coordinate ATPase Activity with Extractor Function.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies key residues in the LptB groove that interact with LptFG, highlighting the importance of these interactions in LPS transport. Mutations in these residues disrupt LPS transport, and suppressor mutations in LptB can rescue defects in LptFG coupling helices.
full_output.methodology: Site-directed mutagenesis, in vivo cross-linking, and complementation assays were used to analyze the role of specific residues in LPS transport.

full_output.paper_title: Recombinant Receptor-Binding Domains of Multiple Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronaviruses (MERS-CoVs) Induce Cross-Neutralizing Antibodies against Divergent Human and Camel MERS-CoVs and Antibody Escape Mutants.

L506F.encodes: receptor-binding domain of MERS-CoV spike protein
L506F.notes: Mutation in the receptor-binding motif (RBM) of the RBD
L506F.evidence_note: The paper mentions that the L506F mutation is part of the receptor-binding motif (RBM) of the RBD and that it affects binding to the DPP4 receptor.

D509G.encodes: receptor-binding domain of MERS-CoV spike protein
D509G.notes: Mutation in the receptor-binding motif (RBM) of the RBD
D509G.evidence_note: The paper mentions that the D509G mutation is part of the receptor-binding motif (RBM) of the RBD and that it reduces DPP4 binding.

D510G.encodes: receptor-binding domain of MERS-CoV spike protein
D510G.notes: Mutation in the receptor-binding motif (RBM) of the RBD
D510G.evidence_note: The paper mentions that the D510G mutation is part of the receptor-binding motif (RBM) of the RBD and that it reduces binding to the DPP4 receptor.

R511A.encodes: receptor-binding domain of MERS-CoV spike protein

mutations_found.effect_on_function: mutant RBDs with diminished DPP4 binding also led to virus attenuation

R511A.notes: Mutation in the receptor-binding motif (RBM) of the RBD
R511A.evidence_note: The paper mentions that R511A is a mutation in the RBM of the RBD and that it affects DPP4 binding.

E513A.encodes: receptor-binding domain of MERS-CoV spike protein

mutations_found.effect_on_function: mutant RBDs exhibited significantly reduced binding activity to recombinant hDPP4

full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes recombinant receptor-binding domains (RBDs) of multiple MERS-CoVs and identifies mutations in the RBD that affect DPP4 binding and viral entry, leading to reduced neutralizing antibody effectiveness.
full_output.methodology: The study uses recombinant RBD proteins, binding assays, and neutralization experiments to analyze mutations in the RBD of MERS-CoV.

full_output.paper_title: Acquisition of Carbapenem Resistance by Plasmid-Encoded-AmpC-Expressing Escherichia coli.

ompC.evidence_note: The paper states that the loss of OmpC was due to the insertion of an IS1 element into the ompC gene.

inc.notes: nucleotide substitution in the inc hairpin loop

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies bla_CMY-2 as a plasmid-encoded AmpC beta-lactamase that contributes to carbapenem resistance in E. coli through increased expression, and mutations in ompC and inc that enhance resistance.
full_output.methodology: Experimental validation through enzyme assays, Western blotting, PCR, and sequencing.

full_output.paper_title: A Novel erm(44) Gene Variant from a Human Staphylococcus saprophyticus Isolate Confers Resistance to Macrolides and Lincosamides but Not Streptogramins.

erm(44)v.mechanism: methylation of 23S rRNA at position A2058
erm(44)v.validation_method: cloning in S. aureus + MIC testing

full_output.key_findings: A novel erm(44)v gene variant was identified in a human Staphylococcus saprophyticus isolate, which confers resistance to macrolides and lincosamides but not to streptogramin B when expressed in S. aureus.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, cloning, and MIC testing.

full_output.paper_title: Selection of Resistance to Clarithromycin in Mycobacterium abscessus Subspecies.

rrl.notes: Mutations at position 2058 and 2059 in the rrl gene were associated with high-level clarithromycin resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified that mutations in the rrl gene, specifically at positions 2058 and 2059, are the primary mechanisms of clarithromycin resistance in Mycobacterium abscessus subspecies. These mutations were found in 100% of mutants from certain subspecies, while others showed lower rates of mutation.
full_output.methodology: The study involved in vitro selection of spontaneous mutants, sequencing of the rrl gene, and determination of MICs for clarithromycin and other antibiotics.

full_output.paper_title: Five-Year Antimicrobial Susceptibility Trends Among Bacterial Isolates from a Tertiary Health-Care Facility in Kigali, Rwanda.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified increasing resistance to imipenem and colistin among gram-negative bacteria in Rwanda, particularly in Acinetobacter spp., Klebsiella spp., and E. coli. Vancomycin remained effective against S. aureus and Enterococcus species.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was performed using the Kirby-Bauer disk diffusion method.

full_output.paper_title: Core-shell magnetic nanoparticles display synergistic antibacterial effects against Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus when combined with cathelicidin LL-37 or selected ceragenins.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that combining core-shell magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs) with antimicrobial agents like LL-37, CSA-13, CSA-131, vancomycin (VAN), and colistin (COL) significantly enhances their antibacterial effects against MRSA and P. aeruginosa, showing synergistic or additive interactions.
full_output.methodology: The study used microdilution methods to determine MIC and MBC values, along with chemiluminescence measurements to assess bacterial viability, and evaluated the synergistic effects of MNPs with antimicrobial agents.

full_output.paper_title: Synthesis and Antibacterial Activity of Quaternary Ammonium 4-Deoxypyridoxine Derivatives.
full_output.key_findings: Two quaternary ammonium 4-deoxypyridoxine derivatives (compounds 4c and 5c) showed excellent activity against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus strains with MICs in the range of 0.5-32 μg/mL, but were inactive against Gram-negative bacteria such as E. coli and P. aeruginosa.
full_output.methodology: Antibacterial activity was assessed using broth microdilution method, cytotoxicity was evaluated via MTT assay, and genotoxicity was analyzed using SOS-chromotest and Ames test.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and Characteristics of Salmonella Isolated from Free-Range Chickens in Shandong Province, China.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that 12.7% of free-range chickens in Shandong Province, China, carried Salmonella, with the most common serotype being Enteritidis. Resistance rates to ampicillin were high (57.9%), while resistance to third-generation cephalosporins was low (7.9%). Multidrug resistance was observed in 26.3% of isolates.
full_output.methodology: The study involved isolation, serotyping, antibiotic susceptibility testing, ERIC-PCR, and MLST analysis of Salmonella isolates from free-range chickens.

full_output.paper_title: The polymyxin B-induced transcriptomic response of a clinical, multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae involves multiple regulatory elements and intracellular targets.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified a truncated mgrB gene as a potential mechanism for polymyxin B resistance in a multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae strain.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic profiling using RNA-seq and qRT-PCR to analyze gene expression changes in response to polymyxin B and abiotic stresses.

full_output.paper_title: Reduced Susceptibility to Extended-Spectrum β-Lactams in Vibrio cholerae Isolated in Bangladesh.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that V. cholerae isolates from Bangladesh exhibited reduced susceptibility to third-generation cephalosporins, but no ESBL or carbapenemase genes were detected in the isolates examined.
full_output.methodology: Disk diffusion and molecular screening for β-lactam resistance genes were performed.

full_output.paper_title: The Listeria monocytogenes PASTA Kinase PrkA and Its Substrate YvcK Are Required for Cell Wall Homeostasis, Metabolism, and Virulence.

YvcK.notes: The T256E mutation mimics phosphorylation of YvcK.
YvcK.evidence_note: The paper states that YvcK is a substrate of PrkA and that the T256E mutation is a phosphomimetic mutation.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies PrkA and YvcK as essential for cell wall homeostasis, glycerol metabolism, and virulence in Listeria monocytogenes. PrkA is required for resistance to cell wall stress and glycerol metabolism, while YvcK is a substrate of PrkA and plays a role in cell wall homeostasis and virulence.
full_output.methodology: The study used genetic knockout mutants, in vitro phosphorylation assays, and in vivo infection models to investigate the roles of PrkA and YvcK in Listeria monocytogenes.

full_output.paper_title: Detection of Isoniazid-, Fluoroquinolone-, Amikacin-, and Kanamycin-Resistant Tuberculosis in an Automated, Multiplexed 10-Color Assay Suitable for Point-of-Care Use.

katG.encodes: Enzyme involved in activation of isoniazid
katG.mechanism: Mutation in katG leads to isoniazid resistance
katG.validation_method: Melting temperature analysis of molecular beacons

gyrA.mechanism: Mutations in gyrA lead to fluoroquinolone resistance
gyrA.validation_method: Melting temperature analysis of molecular beacons

gyrB.mechanism: Mutations in gyrB lead to fluoroquinolone resistance
gyrB.validation_method: Melting temperature analysis of molecular beacons

rrs.mechanism: Mutations in rrs lead to amikacin and kanamycin resistance
rrs.validation_method: Melting temperature analysis of molecular beacons

inhA.mechanism: Mutations in inhA promoter lead to isoniazid resistance
inhA.validation_method: Melting temperature analysis of molecular beacons

full_output.key_findings: The study presents a 10-color assay capable of detecting resistance to isoniazid, fluoroquinolones, amikacin, and kanamycin in Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The assay uses molecular beacons and melting temperature analysis to identify specific mutations in genes such as katG, gyrA, gyrB, rrs, and inhA.
full_output.methodology: The assay utilizes a 10-color, multiplexed PCR with molecular beacons to detect mutations in specific genes associated with drug resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.

full_output.paper_title: Resistance to Biocides in Listeria monocytogenes Collected in Meat-Processing Environments.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the non-specific efflux pumps lde and mdrL as contributing to benzalkonium chloride resistance in Listeria monocytogenes strains isolated from meat-processing environments.
full_output.methodology: Gene expression profiling under biocidal stress and genotypic assay for resistance determinants.

full_output.paper_title: Using genome-wide CRISPR library screening with library resistant DCK to find new sources of Ara-C drug resistance in AML.

DCK.mechanism: Loss of function leads to Ara-C resistance

full_output.methodology: Experimental rat model of MRSA foreign-body osteomyelitis with antimicrobial treatments and bacterial quantification.

full_output.paper_title: Chromosome-Based blaOXA-48-Like Variants in Shewanella Species Isolates from Food-Producing Animals, Fish, and the Aquatic Environment.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies chromosome-based blaOXA-48-like variants in Shewanella species isolates from food-producing animals, fish, and the aquatic environment, including two new alleles, blaOXA-514 and blaOXA-515, which confer resistance to carbapenems.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.
full_output.sample_size: 4,440 fecal samples, 50 batches of imported ornamental fish, and 24 surface freshwater samples

full_output.paper_title: High Prevalence of Pneumocystis jirovecii Dihydropteroate Synthase Gene Mutations in Patients with a First Episode of Pneumocystis Pneumonia in Santiago, Chile, and Clinical Response to Trimethoprim-Sulfamethoxazole Therapy.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified a high prevalence of Pneumocystis jirovecii dihydropteroate synthase (DHPS) gene mutations in patients with a first episode of Pneumocystis pneumonia in Santiago, Chile. These mutations were associated with reduced susceptibility to trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole therapy.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed respiratory specimens from 56 adult patients with a first episode of Pneumocystis pneumonia, using PCR and restriction fragment length polymorphism analysis to detect DHPS gene mutations.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular Characterization of OXA-48-Like-Producing Enterobacteriaceae in the Czech Republic and Evidence for Horizontal Transfer of pOXA-48-Like Plasmids.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterized OXA-48-like-producing Enterobacteriaceae in the Czech Republic, identifying blaOXA-48, blaOXA-181, and blaOXA-232 genes as responsible for carbapenem resistance. It also provided evidence for the horizontal transfer of pOXA-48-like plasmids.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, plasmid analysis, and MLST were used to characterize the isolates and their resistance mechanisms.

full_output.paper_title: Chromosomal Amplification of the blaOXA-58 Carbapenemase Gene in a Proteus mirabilis Clinical Isolate.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the first isolation of a clinical Proteus mirabilis strain producing the OXA-58 carbapenemase, which was found to be chromosomally amplified and integrated into a prophage via XerC-XerD recombination.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, biochemical tests, PCR, and Southern blotting were used to analyze the resistance mechanisms in the clinical isolate.

full_output.paper_title: A bifunctional aminoglycoside acetyltransferase/phosphotransferase conferring tobramycin resistance provides an efficient selectable marker for plastid transformation.

aac(6')-Ie/aph(2'')-Ia.validation_method: transplastomic lines obtained by selection for tobramycin or gentamicin

full_output.key_findings: The aac(6')-Ie/aph(2'')-Ia gene, encoding a bifunctional aminoglycoside acetyltransferase/phosphotransferase, was identified as an efficient selectable marker for plastid transformation in tobacco, conferring resistance to tobramycin and gentamicin.
full_output.methodology: Plastid transformation vectors were constructed and tested for their ability to confer resistance to aminoglycoside antibiotics in tobacco plants.

full_output.paper_title: A PTS EII mutant library in Group A Streptococcus identifies a promiscuous man-family PTS transporter influencing SLS-mediated hemolysis.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the mannose-specific EII transporter (manLMN) as a key player in PTS carbohydrate metabolism and SLS-mediated hemolysis in Group A Streptococcus. full_output.methodology: Generation of an EII mutant library in MGAS5005, followed by metabolic and hemolysis assays to evaluate the impact of each EII on carbohydrate metabolism and hemolysis.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence of Antibiotic Resistance Genes among Human Gut-Derived Bifidobacteria.

tet(W).validation_method: in silico analysis and MIC assays

full_output.methodology: The study utilized in silico analysis, MIC assays, and genomic comparisons to identify and characterize antibiotic resistance genes in Bifidobacterium species.

full_output.paper_title: Analytical and clinical performance characteristics of the Abbott RealTime MTB RIF/INH Resistance, an assay for the detection of rifampicin and isoniazid resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis in pulmonary specimens.
full_output.key_findings: The Abbott RealTime MTB RIF/INH Resistance assay was developed to detect rifampicin and isoniazid resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis. The assay demonstrated high sensitivity and specificity for detecting rifampicin and isoniazid resistance, with specific mutations in the rpoB, katG, and inhA genes being identified as responsible for resistance.
full_output.methodology: The assay was evaluated for its analytical and clinical performance, including sensitivity, specificity, and ability to detect resistance mutations in the rpoB, katG, and inhA genes through sequencing of the assay amplicons.

full_output.paper_title: Platensimycin and platencin: Inspirations for chemistry, biology, enzymology, and medicine.
full_output.key_findings: This review discusses the discovery, mode of action, and biosynthesis of platensimycin (PTM) and platencin (PTN), highlighting their unique structures and mechanisms of inhibiting bacterial fatty acid synthesis. It also explores their potential as novel antibiotics and the challenges in their development.
full_output.methodology: The study involves the analysis of natural product discovery, biochemical assays, and genomic studies to understand the biosynthesis and resistance mechanisms of PTM and PTN.

full_output.paper_title: A Nitric Oxide Storage and Transport System That Protects Activated Macrophages from Endogenous Nitric Oxide Cytotoxicity.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies MRP1 and GSTP1 as critical components of a nitric oxide (NO) storage and transport system in activated macrophages, which protects them from NO-induced cytotoxicity by facilitating the efflux of dinitrosyl-dithiol iron complexes (DNICs).

full_output.paper_title: Changes in the Expression of Biofilm-Associated Surface Proteins in Staphylococcus aureus Food-Environmental Isolates Subjected to Sublethal Concentrations of Disinfectants.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies several surface-exposed proteins in Staphylococcus aureus that are differentially regulated in response to sublethal concentrations of ethanol and chloramine T, suggesting a role in biofilm adaptation and resistance mechanisms.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized Syto9 biofilm quantification, trypsin shaving, and LC-LTQ/Orbitrap MS to analyze changes in surface protein expression in S. aureus biofilms exposed to disinfectants.

full_output.paper_title: Global transcriptome responses including small RNAs during mixed-species interactions with methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies PA1595 and Panton-Valentine leukocidin (lukS-PV and lukF-PV) as essential for competitive success in mixed-species biofilms of Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus.
full_output.methodology: RNA sequencing and competitive index analysis were used to identify differentially expressed genes and validate their roles in mixed-species biofilm interactions.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial Activity of Zabofloxacin against Clinically Isolated Streptococcus pneumoniae.
full_output.key_findings: Zabofloxacin shows potent in vitro and in vivo activity against drug-resistant Streptococcus pneumoniae, including quinolone-resistant strains. Mutations in the quinolone resistance-determining regions (QRDR) of gyrA, parC, and parE contribute to resistance against fluoroquinolones.
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing, PCR, sequencing, time-kill analysis, and mouse infection models were used to evaluate the activity and resistance mechanisms of zabofloxacin against Streptococcus pneumoniae.

full_output.paper_title: Design of New Antibacterial Enhancers Based on AcrB's Structure and the Evaluation of Their Antibacterial Enhancement Activity.

acrB.validation_method: synergy testing with antibiotics, efflux pump inhibition, mRNA expression analysis

full_output.methodology: Molecular docking, synergy testing, efflux pump inhibition assays, and mRNA expression analysis.
full_output.sample_size: Various E. coli strains including clinical isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of IncA/C Plasmid Replication and Maintenance Genes and Development of a Plasmid Multilocus Sequence Typing Scheme.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies essential genes for IncA/C plasmid replication and maintenance, develops a plasmid multilocus sequence typing (PMLST) scheme, and reveals the widespread dissemination of bla NDM-1-containing plasmids.

full_output.paper_title: First identification of NDM-4-producing Escherichia coli ST410 in China.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the first identification of NDM-4-producing E. coli ST410 in China, highlighting the emergence of this multidrug-resistant clone and the role of IncX3 plasmids in the dissemination of NDM-type metallo-beta-lactamases.
full_output.methodology: PCR, sequencing, and susceptibility testing were used to identify and characterize the NDM-4-producing E. coli isolate.

full_output.key_findings: The study reports the detection of Clostridium difficile in environmental samples, including puddle water and soil, and identifies antimicrobial resistance patterns among these isolates. It highlights the presence of non-toxigenic, highly divergent strains in soil, suggesting the environment as a potential reservoir of genetically diverse C. difficile populations.
full_output.methodology: The study involved isolation and characterization of C. difficile from environmental samples, followed by antimicrobial susceptibility testing and molecular analysis including PCR ribotyping, toxinotyping, and MLST.

full_output.key_findings: The study found that dietary grape seed proanthocyanidins (GSPs) improved growth performance, reduced diarrhea incidence, and enhanced intestinal barrier function in weaned piglets. GSPs also increased the abundance and diversity of intestinal bacteria and the concentration of propionic and butyric acids, which may activate GPR41 signaling pathways.

full_output.paper_title: Studies on the therapeutic effect of propolis along with standard antibacterial drug in Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium infected BALB/c mice.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated the therapeutic effect of propolis in combination with cefixime against Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium infection in BALB/c mice, demonstrating improved survival and reduced bacterial load.
full_output.methodology: The study used BALB/c mice infected with Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium and assessed the effects of propolis and cefixime combinations on survival, bacterial load, and organ pathology.

full_output.paper_title: Correlation of phenotypic tests with the presence of the blaZ gene for detection of beta-lactamase.

blaZ.validation_method: PCR detection of blaZ gene and correlation with phenotypic resistance tests

full_output.key_findings: The study found that the blaZ gene is strongly correlated with penicillin resistance in Staphylococcus spp., particularly in S. saprophyticus. The zone edge test was the most sensitive phenotypic method for detecting beta-lactamase production.

full_output.paper_title: Membrane-Active Epithelial Keratin 6A Fragments (KAMPs) Are Unique Human Antimicrobial Peptides with a Non-αβ Structure.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified KAMPs derived from human epithelial keratin 6A as unique antimicrobial peptides with a non-αβ structure, demonstrating bactericidal activity against Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus through membrane disruption.

full_output.paper_title: Streptococcus pneumoniae disrupts pulmonary immune defence via elastase release following pneumolysin-dependent neutrophil lysis.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence of colonization by methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus ST398 in pigs and pig farm workers in an area of Catalonia, Spain.

full_output.paper_title: Effect of β-Lactamase inhibitors on in vitro activity of β-Lactam antibiotics against Burkholderia cepacia complex species.

However, resistance mechanisms vary among strains and include non-β-lactamase-mediated factors.

full_output.paper_title: Biochemical Characterization of Glutamate Racemase-A New Candidate Drug Target against Burkholderia cenocepacia Infections.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic resistance and clonal diversity of invasive Staphylococcus aureus in the rural Ashanti Region, Ghana.

full_output.paper_title: New agents approved for treatment of acute staphylococcal skin infections.

full_output.methodology: Review of clinical trials and in vitro studies evaluating the efficacy and resistance profiles of dalbavancin, oritavancin, and tedizolid.

full_output.paper_title: Performance of the G4 Xpert(®) MTB/RIF assay for the detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis and rifampin resistance: a retrospective case-control study of analytical and clinical samples from high- and low-tuberculosis prevalence settings.

full_output.methodology: The study used a combination of analytical and clinical testing, including Xpert assay, culture, and bi-directional sequencing of the rpoB gene to validate results.

full_output.paper_title: Rise of multidrug-resistant non-vaccine serotype 15A Streptococcus pneumoniae in the United Kingdom, 2001 to 2014.

full_output.paper_title: Synergistic Interaction Between Phage Therapy and Antibiotics Clears Pseudomonas Aeruginosa Infection in Endocarditis and Reduces Virulence.

full_output.paper_title: Presence of environmental coagulase-positive staphylococci, their clonal relationship, resistance factors and ability to form biofilm.

full_output.paper_title: Identification and Characterization of the Sulfazecin Monobactam Biosynthetic Gene Cluster.

full_output.methodology: Transposon mutagenesis, gene cloning, sequence analysis, and biochemical assays were used to characterize the sulfazecin biosynthetic gene cluster and its enzymatic functions.

full_output.paper_title: A Mechanism of Synergistic Effect of Streptomycin and Cefotaxime on CTX-M-15 Type β-lactamase Producing Strain of E. cloacae: A First Report.

full_output.paper_title: The TIR Homologue Lies near Resistance Genes in Staphylococcus aureus, Coupling Modulation of Virulence and Antimicrobial Susceptibility.

full_output.paper_title: Multidrug resistance transporter profile reveals MDR3 as a marker for stratification of blastemal Wilms tumour patients.

full_output.paper_title: Evaluation of MLVA for epidemiological typing and outbreak detection of ESBL-producing Escherichia coli in Sweden.

full_output.paper_title: The occurrence of ESBL-producing Escherichia coli carrying aminoglycoside resistance genes in urinary tract infections in Saudi Arabia.

full_output.paper_title: Antibacterial activities of the methanol extract, fractions and compounds from Elaeophorbia drupifera (Thonn.) Stapf. (Euphorbiaceae).

full_output.paper_title: Extraintestinal Pathogenic and Antimicrobial-Resistant Escherichia coli, Including Sequence Type 131 (ST131), from Retail Chicken Breasts in the United States in 2013.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial resistance in Staphylococcus pseudintermedius and the molecular epidemiology of methicillin-resistant S. pseudintermedius in small animals in Finland.

full_output.paper_title: Multidrug- and Extensively Drug-Resistant Uropathogenic Escherichia coli Clinical Strains: Phylogenetic Groups Widely Associated with Integrons Maintain High Genetic Diversity.

full_output.paper_title: Cinnamaldehyde Inhibits Staphylococcus aureus Virulence Factors and Protects against Infection in a Galleria mellonella Model.

full_output.paper_title: Altered Outer Membrane Transcriptome Balance with AmpC Overexpression in Carbapenem-Resistant Enterobacter cloacae.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the presence of the blaOXA-48 carbapenemase in two carbapenem-resistant Enterobacter cloacae strains, along with the overproduction of AmpC β-lactamase and alterations in the outer membrane transcriptome balance as mechanisms of carbapenem resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study investigates the anti-biofilm activity of Pseudomonas aeruginosa alkylhydroxyquinolone (AHQ) autoinducers, specifically 2-heptyl-4-quinolone (HHQ) and 2-heptyl-3-hydroxy-4-quinolone (PQS), against the fungal pathogen Aspergillus fumigatus. full_output.paper_title: Coxiella burnetii Employs the Dot/Icm Type IV Secretion System to Modulate Host NF-κB/RelA Activation.

full_output.paper_title: Bioactivity of Natural and Engineered Antimicrobial Peptides from Venom of the Scorpions Urodacus yaschenkoi and U. manicatus.

full_output.paper_title: Molecular Mimics of Classic P-Glycoprotein Inhibitors as Multidrug Resistance Suppressors and Their Synergistic Effect on Paclitaxel.

full_output.paper_title: Surveillance of Clostridium difficile Infections: Results from a Six-Year Retrospective Study in Nine Hospitals of a North Italian Local Health Authority.
