full_output.key_findings: The study identified Bap, csuE, and blaPER1 genes associated with biofilm formation and carbapenem resistance in Acinetobacter calcoaceticus-baumannii complex isolates.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of biofilm-related genes and antibiotic susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Acceptable concentrations of enrofloxacin in food lead to reduced enrofloxacin susceptibility in a mouse model of gastrointestinal Klebsiella pneumoniae.

nnr.notes: The missense mutation Asn288Ser in the nnr gene was identified in the one-tenth ADI group sample.

full_output.key_findings: The study found that enrofloxacin doses as low as one-tenth of the acceptable daily intake increased the enrofloxacin MICs of gastrointestinal Klebsiella pneumoniae. A missense mutation (Asn288Ser) in the nnr gene was identified in the one-tenth ADI group sample.
full_output.methodology: The study used a mouse model to assess the effect of enrofloxacin doses on Klebsiella pneumoniae susceptibility, with whole genome sequencing to identify mutations.

full_output.paper_title: Comprehensive evaluation of the MeltPro MTB/PZA assay for prediction of pyrazinamide resistance in multidrug-resistant tuberculosis.

pncA.validation_method: whole-genome sequencing and phenotypic drug-susceptibility testing

pncA.notes: mutations in pncA are strongly associated with pyrazinamide resistance

blaOXA-23.validation_method: whole genome sequencing and antibiotic susceptibility testing

blaOXA-66.validation_method: whole genome sequencing and antibiotic susceptibility testing

blaADC-73.validation_method: whole genome sequencing and antibiotic susceptibility testing

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies blaOXA-23, blaOXA-66, and blaADC-73 as carbapenem resistance genes in Carbapenem-Resistant Acinetobacter baumannii (CRAB) isolates from patients with COVID-19 in Chinese ICUs.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing, antibiotic susceptibility testing, and biofilm formation assays.

full_output.paper_title: Spread of the novel vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium strain ST1299/vanA from local level in Germany to cross-border level in Austria, 2018 to 2022.

full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and comparative genomics analyses were used to track the spread and characterize resistance mechanisms of the ST1299/vanA strain.

full_output.paper_title: Contribution of RND superfamily multidrug efflux pumps AdeABC, AdeFGH, and AdeIJK to antimicrobial resistance and virulence factors in multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii AYE.

Disruption of these pumps reduces resistance to multiple antimicrobial classes and affects biofilm formation and virulence.
full_output.methodology: Construction of isogenic deletion mutants and antimicrobial susceptibility testing.

full_output.paper_title: Characterization of a bla(KPC-3)-carrying plasmid in a clinical isolate of Klebsiella pneumoniae belonging to the emerging successful clone ST147.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes a bla(KPC-3)-carrying plasmid in a clinical isolate of Klebsiella pneumoniae ST147, highlighting its resistance to carbapenems and other antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Sequencing, plasmid analysis, and comparative genomics were used to analyze the resistance mechanisms in the clinical isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Study on collateral sensitivity of tigecycline to colistin-resistant Enterobacter cloacae complex.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified that tigecycline resistance in colistin-resistant Enterobacter cloacae complex (CRECC) is primarily due to the overexpression of ramA, which activates the AcrAB-TolC efflux pump. Mutations in ramR, such as Stop185 and Frameshift, lead to the loss of repression of ramA, contributing to tigecycline resistance. The reduced sensitivity to colistin is linked to disruptions in lipid synthesis caused by ramA overexpression.
full_output.methodology: Sanger sequencing, RT-qPCR, and broth microdilution for determining MICs.

full_output.paper_title: Interaction of the SXT/R391 element ICEPmiJpn1 with its natural host Proteus mirabilis.

blaCMY-2.validation_method: cloning in E. coli + MIC testing

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the blaCMY-2 gene carried by the ICE Pmi Jpn1, which confers ampicillin resistance in Proteus mirabilis and Escherichia coli.
full_output.methodology: The study used isogenic strains of P. mirabilis with and without the ICE Pmi Jpn1, along with E. coli as a recipient, to analyze the effects of the ICE on bacterial physiology and conjugative transfer.

full_output.paper_title: Transmissible antimicrobial resistance in Escherichia coli isolated from household drinking water in Ibadan, Nigeria.

blaTEM-1B.evidence_note: The gene blaTEM-1B was identified in 13 isolates and is associated with beta-lactam resistance.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes in E. coli isolates from household water in Ibadan, Nigeria, including blaTEM-1B, dfrA14, tetA, qnrS1, and mcr-1, highlighting the potential for horizontal gene transfer and the risk of AMR spread in the environment.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and conjugation experiments were used to identify and characterize AMR genes in E. coli isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Mining the heparinome for cryptic antimicrobial peptides that selectively kill Gram-negative bacteria.

blaHBP-5.mechanism: LPS interaction, membrane depolarization and cell wall disruption
blaHBP-5.evidence_note: The paper describes blaHBP-5 as an antimicrobial peptide derived from heparin-binding proteins, which exhibits strong activity against Gram-negative bacteria. The mechanism of action involves LPS interaction, membrane depolarization, and cell wall disruption.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies several synthetic peptides derived from heparin-binding proteins (HBPs) that demonstrate strong antimicrobial activity against Gram-negative bacteria. These peptides, including HBP-5, show high affinity for heparin and lipopolysaccharides (LPS) and effectively disrupt bacterial cell walls.
full_output.methodology: The research utilized computational predictions, synthesis of peptides, and experimental validation through antimicrobial assays, LPS binding assays, and structural analyses.

full_output.paper_title: Titanium dioxide nanoparticles augment Ciprofloxacin activity via Inhibition of biofilm formation for multidrug resistance bacteria in-vitro and insilco prediction study.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that combining ciprofloxacin (CIP) with titanium dioxide nanoparticles (TiO2 NPs) enhances antibacterial activity against multidrug-resistant bacteria, particularly Klebsiella pneumoniae and Streptococcus mutans, by inhibiting biofilm formation and increasing the effectiveness of the antibiotic.
full_output.methodology: The study used a combination of experimental methods including UV-Vis spectroscopy, XRD, FESEM, TEM, FTIR, molecular docking simulations, and MIC assays to evaluate the antibacterial and anti-biofilm properties of CIP@TiO2 NPs.

full_output.paper_title: A Supramolecular Material for Controlling Kiwifruit Bacterial Canker.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the synthesis and evaluation of a matrine-5-methylsalicylic acid salt (MOS) and its supramolecular formulation MOS@HPCD for controlling kiwifruit bacterial canker caused by Pseudomonas syringae pv. actinidiae (Psa). MOS exhibits potent antibacterial activity against Psa, disrupting the bacterial cell membrane and targeting essential proteins like FtsZ and DNA helicase. The supramolecular formulation MOS@HPCD enhances solubility, penetration, and sustained release, leading to improved antibacterial efficacy.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the synthesis and characterization of MOS, in vitro and in vivo antibacterial assays, molecular dynamics simulations, and evaluation of the supramolecular formulation MOS@HPCD.

full_output.paper_title: A consortium of seven commensal bacteria promotes gut microbiota recovery and strengthens ecological barrier against vancomycin-resistant enterococci.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies a consortium of seven commensal bacteria that promote gut microbiota recovery and reduce vancomycin-resistant enterococci (VRE) colonization. The research highlights the role of specific bacterial species in enhancing the ecological barrier against VRE.
full_output.methodology: The study combines longitudinal analysis of gut microbiota composition, mathematical modeling, and in vivo experiments to evaluate the impact of commensal bacteria on VRE colonization.

full_output.paper_title: Mycobacterium abscessus persistence in the face of Pseudomonas aeruginosa antagonism.

lasR.notes: lasR is a regulator whose mutation/loss is the resistance mechanism.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies that the Pa-derived factor SPAM, which is regulated by LasR, has potent mycobactericidal activity against Mab. Additionally, the study reveals that Mab adapts to Pa by entering a slow-growing persister-like state and upregulating genes involved in horizontal gene transfer and stress response.
full_output.methodology: The study used co-culturing experiments, dual RNA-seq analysis, and biochemical assays to investigate interactions between Pa and Mab.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic profiling of Streptococcus agalactiae (Group B Streptococcus) isolates from pregnant women in northeastern Mexico: clonal complexes, virulence factors, and antibiotic resistance.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of mreA and tetM genes in all 51 S. agalactiae isolates, indicating widespread macrolide and tetracycline resistance. The mreA gene was found in 100% of isolates, while tetM was present in 60.1% of isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Effective simultaneous removal of 17β-estradiol and tetracycline by a novel Alkalibacterium strain: characteristics, mechanisms, and application in livestock wastewater treatment.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified various AMR genes in E. coli isolates from drinking water in Van, Turkey, including blaTEM, blaSHV, blaCTX-M, tetA, tetB, qnrS, and aac(6')-Ib-cr, indicating widespread antibiotic resistance.
full_output.methodology: PCR and sequencing were used to detect AMR genes and virulence factors in E. coli isolates.

full_output.paper_title: First characterization of the resistome, virulome and genomic diversity of Salmonella enterica serovar Inganda: a rare, clinically-related and drug susceptible serovar.

parC.notes: mutation in the quinolone resistance-determining region

full_output.paper_title: Diverse impacts of different rpoB mutations on the anti-tuberculosis efficacy of capreomycin.

rpoB.notes: Mutations at codon 435 (D435G, D435V) conferred increased CAP tolerance, while mutations at codon 445 (H445Y, H445R) enhanced CAP bactericidal effect.

full_output.key_findings: Different rpoB mutations have varying impacts on the bactericidal effect of capreomycin (CAP). Mutations at codon 435 (D435G, D435V) increase CAP tolerance, while mutations at codon 445 (H445Y, H445R) enhance CAP bactericidal activity.
full_output.methodology: Time-kill assays and phenotypic drug susceptibility testing were used to assess the impact of rpoB mutations on CAP efficacy.

full_output.paper_title: Species diversity, virulence, and antimicrobial resistance of the nasal staphylococcal and mammaliicoccal biota of reindeer.

mecA.notes: mecA gene was detected in 24% of strains (M. sciuri, M. lentus, S. chromogenes), but phenotypic methicillin resistance was not confirmed in any of these bacteria.

full_output.key_findings: The study identified a diverse range of staphylococcal and mammaliicoccal species in the nasal microbiota of reindeer, with M. sciuri showing the highest antimicrobial resistance (100%). The mecA gene, associated with methicillin resistance, was detected in several strains, though phenotypic methicillin resistance was not confirmed in all cases.
full_output.methodology: The study involved isolation and identification of bacteria from nasal swabs, PCR-RFLP analysis, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing using the disk diffusion method.

full_output.paper_title: Epidemiology and resistant profile of bacterial pathogens in a tertiary health care hospital, Medan City: a retrospective study.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high levels of antimicrobial resistance among bacterial pathogens, particularly Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae, with a notable prevalence of extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL)-producing strains. Coagulase-negative staphylococci (CoNS) and methicillin-resistant S. aureus (MRSA) also showed significant resistance patterns.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of clinical microbiology data, including antimicrobial susceptibility testing using Vitek 2 and disk diffusion methods.

full_output.paper_title: A comparative study to investigate foodborne pathogenic bacteria in fresh and imported frozen Scomber japonicus (Houttuyn, 1782) in Tripoli, Libya.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high levels of antibiotic resistance in gram-negative bacteria isolated from fresh and frozen chub mackerel fish, including resistance to β-lactam antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Bacterial isolation, biochemical identification, and antibiotic susceptibility testing using the Kirby-Bauer technique.

full_output.paper_title: Contamination of meat and its products by Pseudomonas species and assessment of the antibacterial effect of clove (Syzygium aromaticum) essential oil on multidrug-resistant P. aeruginosa.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of blaSHV and Mcr1 genes in multidrug-resistant P. aeruginosa isolates from meat products, highlighting their role in resistance to several antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection of antibiotic resistance genes and antimicrobial susceptibility testing using disk diffusion and MIC/MBC assays.

full_output.paper_title: Environmental pH controls antimicrobial production by human probiotic Streptococcus salivarius.
full_output.key_findings: The study reveals that environmental pH regulates the expression of the sar-BGC gene cluster in Streptococcus salivarius K12, leading to the production of salivabactin, an antimicrobial compound active under acidic conditions.
full_output.methodology: Transcript analysis, pH manipulation experiments, and structural biology techniques were used to investigate the relationship between environmental pH and antimicrobial production.

full_output.paper_title: Population pharmacokinetics of meropenem-vaborbactam in acutely ill hospitalized patients with various degrees of renal dysfunction including continuous renal replacement therapy.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the population pharmacokinetics of meropenem-vaborbactam (MVB) in patients with renal dysfunction, including those on continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT). It identifies that CRRT significantly reduces drug clearance, leading to vaborbactam accumulation compared to meropenem. The research highlights challenges in achieving optimal PK/PD targets for MVB in patients with elevated MICs.
full_output.methodology: The study employed a population pharmacokinetic modeling approach using data from patients receiving MVB, incorporating CRRT and renal function parameters to predict drug exposure and target attainment.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic analysis of invasive and non-invasive disease-causing Streptococcus pneumoniae isolated from children between 2014 and 2023 in Suzhou, China.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that 99.8% of S. pneumoniae isolates were predicted to be resistant to at least one antibiotic tested, highlighting the high levels of antimicrobial resistance in the Suzhou pneumococcal population.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis were used to determine serotypes and antibiotic resistance profiles.

full_output.paper_title: First detection of resistance genes and virulence factors in Escherichia coli and Salmonella spp in Togo: the case of imported chicken and frozen by-products.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified blaTEM, blaCTX, qnrB, and intI1 as resistance genes in Escherichia coli and Salmonella spp. from imported poultry in Togo, highlighting the presence of multidrug-resistant strains and the need for improved surveillance.
full_output.methodology: Antibiotic susceptibility testing using disk diffusion, PCR for detection of resistance and virulence genes, and molecular characterization of isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Natural flavonoids combat cytosolic MRSA by potentiating phagosome acidification.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies that natural flavonoids combat cytosolic MRSA by enhancing phagosome acidification, thereby improving host defense mechanisms against intracellular bacterial infections.
full_output.methodology: The study used in vitro and in vivo models, transcriptome and proteome analysis, and immunofluorescence to evaluate the antibacterial effects of flavonoids against MRSA.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies AtDTX1, AtDTX3, and AtABCB4 as transporters involved in 3-ADON efflux in Arabidopsis thaliana. AtDTX1 is particularly implicated in the efflux of 3-ADON, while the roles of AtDTX3 and AtABCB4 are also noted.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptomic analyses, RT-qPCR, and functional assays were used to characterize the transporters involved in 3-ADON efflux.

full_output.paper_title: Therapeutic Drug Monitoring of Amikacin and Colistin in Patients with Multidrug-Resistant Gram-Negative Infections Using a Portable Plasmonic Biosensor.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents a portable plasmonic biosensor for rapid therapeutic drug monitoring of amikacin and colistin, crucial antibiotics for treating multidrug-resistant Gram-negative infections. The biosensor offers high specificity and sensitivity, with limits of detection of 0.92 ng/mL for amikacin and 9.11 pg/mL for colistin in blood serum, demonstrating strong correlation with standard analytical methods.
full_output.methodology: The biosensor utilizes surface plasmon resonance to detect changes in refractive index due to biomolecular interactions, employing competitive immunoassays with antibody-conjugated sensors for amikacin and colistin detection.

full_output.paper_title: Antibiotic resistance and population structure of Staphylococcus epidermidis from prosthetic joint infections in Sweden and France.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several AMR genes and mutations in Staphylococcus epidermidis isolates from prosthetic joint infections in Sweden and France, highlighting regional differences in AMR gene prevalence, especially for streptogramin resistance genes.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing and analysis using ARIBA and ResFinder databases to identify AMR genes and mutations.

full_output.paper_title: Metabolic Activation versus Masked Prodrugs: Bisubstrate Mimic Inhibitors of CoaBC's PPCS Activity in Mycobacterium tuberculosis and Staphylococcus aureus.
full_output.key_findings: The study characterizes the inhibition of CoaBC's PPCS activity by P-CJ-CMP, demonstrating its effectiveness as a bisubstrate mimic inhibitor in both Mycobacterium tuberculosis and Staphylococcus aureus. It also explores the synthesis and evaluation of masked prodrugs of P-CJ as potential inhibitors.
full_output.methodology: The study uses biochemical assays, including kinetic evaluations, differential scanning fluorimetry, and whole-cell growth inhibition tests, to assess the efficacy of various inhibitors against CoaBC.

full_output.paper_title: Antibacterial, antibiofilm and anti-quorum sensing activities of 1,2,3,5-tetrazine derivatives linked to a benzothiazole moiety.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluates the antibacterial, antibiofilm, and anti-quorum sensing activities of 1,2,3,5-tetrazine derivatives linked to a benzothiazole moiety. Compounds 4a, 4b, and 4c showed significant antibacterial activity with MIC values ranging from 8 to 128 µg/mL and MBC values from 32 to 256 µg/mL. They also inhibited biofilm formation in four bacteria with more than 50% inhibition. Additionally, these compounds exhibited anti-quorum sensing activity by reducing violacein production.
full_output.methodology: The antibacterial, antibiofilm, and anti-quorum sensing activities of the synthesized compounds were evaluated using microdilution methods, biofilm assays, and violacein production inhibition assays.

full_output.paper_title: Antimicrobial resistance surveillance of gram-negative bacteria among solid organ transplant recipients, a 4-year retrospective study.
full_output.key_findings: The study highlights the increasing resistance patterns of gram-negative bacteria, particularly carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales, among solid organ transplant recipients, emphasizing the need for antibiotic stewardship.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of antimicrobial resistance patterns in gram-negative bacterial isolates from solid organ transplant recipients.

full_output.paper_title: Investigation of potential relationship betweenmazEF3, relJK, and vapBC3 genes and antimicrobial resistance inMycobacterium bovis.

full_output.paper_title: Convergence of multidrug resistance and efflux-mediated biocide tolerance in klebsiella pneumoniae ST307: implications for nosocomial infection control in Iranian hospitals.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies several AMR genes, including bla CTX−M−15, bla SHV, bla TEM, bla OXA−48, bla NDM−1, cepA, and qacED1, in Klebsiella pneumoniae ST307 isolates from Iranian hospitals, highlighting their role in multidrug resistance and biocide tolerance.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and biocide susceptibility testing to characterize AMR genes and resistance profiles in K. pneumoniae ST307 isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Antidepressant drugs promote the spread of broad-host-range plasmid in mouse and human gut microbiota.
full_output.key_findings: Antidepressants enhance the conjugation rate of the broad-host-range plasmid pKJK5 in mouse and human gut microbiota, promoting horizontal gene transfer of antibiotic resistance genes.
full_output.methodology: In vitro conjugation assays, flow cytometry, 16S rRNA gene sequencing, and human gut simulator system.

full_output.paper_title: Resistance mechanisms and tedizolid susceptibility in clinical isolates of linezolid-resistant bacteria in Japan.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the G2576T and T2504A mutations in the 23S rRNA gene, along with the resistance genes cfr, optrA, fexA, and fexB, contributing to linezolid and tedizolid resistance in Enterococcus faecium and Enterococcus faecalis isolates in Japan.
full_output.methodology: PCR detection, sequencing, and MIC testing were used to analyze resistance mechanisms and susceptibility.

full_output.paper_title: Resisting the resistance: the antimicrobial peptide DGL13K selects for small colony variants of Staphylococcus aureus that show increased resistance to its stereoisomer LGL13K, but not to DGL13K.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mutations in the chorismate/menaquinone biosynthetic pathway in S. aureus that result in increased resistance to LGL13K but not DGL13K. Specifically, mutations in aroF, menA, menH, and frsA were found in peptide-selected isolates.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing and MIC assays were used to identify and validate mutations in S. aureus isolates selected for resistance to LGL13K and DGL13K.

full_output.paper_title: Genomic characterization of vancomycin-resistant enterococci in Norwegian poultry.

vanA.mechanism: confers resistance to vancomycin
vanA.validation_method: whole genome sequencing and plasmid analysis

full_output.key_findings: The study identified vanA and narAB genes on pVEF-like plasmids in vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium and E. hirae isolates from Norwegian poultry, along with additional resistance genes such as ermB, tetM, and aac(6')-Ii.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis of 30 VRE isolates from Norwegian poultry.

full_output.paper_title: Ciprofloxacin resistance rapidly declines in nfxB defective clinical strains of Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that ciprofloxacin resistance in nfxB-defective Pseudomonas aeruginosa clinical strains can rapidly decline in antibiotic-free environments due to compensatory mutations in the mexCD-oprJ operon, particularly in mexC and mexD genes.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, MIC testing, and competitive growth assays were used to analyze the decline of ciprofloxacin resistance in nfxB-defective strains.

full_output.paper_title: A novel peptide mimetic, brilacidin, for combating multidrug-resistant Neisseria gonorrhoeae.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified brilacidin as a potent anti-gonococcal agent effective against multiple multidrug-resistant strains of Neisseria gonorrhoeae, showing rapid bactericidal activity and superiority over ceftriaxone in clearing intracellular bacteria.
full_output.methodology: Antibacterial susceptibility analysis, time-kill kinetics, intracellular bacterial clearance assay, cytotoxicity and hemolysis assays, permeability assays.

full_output.paper_title: Resistance trend in bacteria isolated from corneal ulcers: A retrospective analysis from Pakistan.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified high levels of antibiotic resistance in bacteria isolated from corneal ulcers, with Pseudomonas aeruginosa showing complete resistance to ciprofloxacin and methicillin-resistant coagulase-negative staphylococci (MR-CoNS) displaying multidrug resistance.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective analysis of bacterial isolates from corneal ulcers, including antibiotic susceptibility testing using disc diffusion and MIC methods.

full_output.paper_title: Integrated genomic-epigenomic-transcriptomic analyses reveal adaptive mechanisms of colistin and carbapenem resistance in Klebsiella pneumoniae and Enterobacter isolates

ompK35.notes: mutations in ompK35 confer resistance to carbapenems

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies multiple AMR genes and mutations associated with colistin and carbapenem resistance in Klebsiella pneumoniae and Enterobacter isolates, including beta-lactamases, fosfomycin resistance genes, and efflux pumps. Mutations in ompK35 were found to contribute to carbapenem resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing, epigenomics, and transcriptomics were used to analyze AMR mechanisms in clinical isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Structure-activity relationship study of benserazide derivatives as PilB inhibitors.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies benserazide derivatives as potent inhibitors of PilB, a type IV pilus assembly ATPase, with 11c showing the highest potency (IC50 of 0.58 μM).
full_output.methodology: Synthesis and in vitro evaluation of benserazide derivatives using a malachite green assay to assess PilB inhibition.

full_output.paper_title: Chemokines kill bacteria without triggering antimicrobial resistance by binding anionic phospholipids.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies that chemokines with antimicrobial activity bind to anionic phospholipids, specifically cardiolipin (CL) and phosphatidylglycerol (PG), and that this binding is essential for their bactericidal effects. It also demonstrates that bacteria deficient in CL are more resistant to these chemokines, highlighting the critical role of CL in the antimicrobial mechanism of chemokines.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized biolayer interferometry, fluorescence assays, and liposome experiments to investigate the binding and antimicrobial activity of chemokines against bacterial strains.

full_output.paper_title: Functional characterization of the chaperone DnaK of Riemerella anatipestifer in antibiotic resistance and pathogenicity.

dnaK.mechanism: resistance via reducing oxidative stress and maintaining cell structure
dnaK.validation_method: MIC testing and time-dependent killing assay

full_output.key_findings: The DnaK chaperone of Riemerella anatipestifer contributes to antibiotic resistance by reducing oxidative stress and maintaining cell morphology. Deletion of dnaK increases susceptibility to several antibiotics and impairs pathogenicity.
full_output.methodology: MIC determination, time-dependent killing assay, ROS detection, and morphological analysis.

full_output.paper_title: Antibacterial activity of the novel peptide Pac-525 with the RGD motif against intracellular Escherichia coli.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that the RGD-Pac525 peptide exhibits significant antibacterial activity against intracellular E. coli KV203, reducing bacterial burden in macrophages, chicken intestinal organoids, and chicken embryos. The peptide shows improved efficacy compared to Pac525 alone, with a 50% reduction in intracellular bacteria.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized in vitro and in vivo models, including macrophage cell lines, chicken intestinal organoids, and the chorioallantoic membrane (CAM) assay, to evaluate the antibacterial effects of RGD-Pac525 against intracellular E. coli KV203.

full_output.paper_title: Convergent evolution of antibiotic resistance mechanisms between pyrrolobenzodiazepines and albicidin in multidrug resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae.

albA.mechanism: resistance to pyrrolobenzodiazepines and albicidin by binding and sequestering the antibiotics
albA.role_in_paper: The gene albA was shown to confer resistance to pyrrolobenzodiazepines (PBDs) and albicidin by binding and sequestering the antibiotics.
albA.genetic_context: Mutations in the MerR-family protein albA were identified in PBD-resistant isolates of K. pneumoniae.
albA.source: Convergent evolution of antibiotic resistance mechanisms between pyrrolobenzodiazepines and albicidin in multidrug resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae.
albA.evidence_note: The study demonstrated that mutations in albA, particularly the L120Q substitution, conferred resistance to PBDs and albicidin. Heterologous expression of AlbA in E. coli and the introduction of the L120Q modification in K. pneumoniae resulted in increased MICs, indicating resistance. Proteomic analysis showed elevated AlbA protein levels in resistant strains.

The paper states that mutations in the albA gene, specifically L120Q, were identified in PBD-resistant isolates of K. pneumoniae. The L120Q modification was engineered into the genome of a drug-sensitive K. pneumoniae strain, resulting in a 32-fold increase in MIC, indicating that this mutation confers resistance to PBDs and albicidin. The paper also mentions that AlbA was expressed in E. coli, and the presence of the L120Q mutation conferred resistance to PBDs and albicidin.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies tsx and albA as key genes involved in resistance to pyrrolobenzodiazepines (PBDs) in Klebsiella pneumoniae. Mutations in tsx and the L120Q variant of albA confer resistance to PBDs and albicidin.
full_output.methodology: Genome sequencing, transposon insertion, site-directed mutagenesis, heterologous expression, MIC testing, proteomics, and X-ray crystallography.

full_output.paper_title: Association with Elevated Somatic Cell Counts and Characterization of Aerococcus viridans Isolates from Bovine Mastitis Milk in South Korea.
full_output.key_findings: A. viridans isolates from bovine mastitis milk showed high resistance to ceftiofur (46.4%), oxacillin + 2% NaCl (44.9%), tetracycline (36.2%), and erythromycin (10.1%).
full_output.methodology: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing using broth microdilution and disk diffusion methods.

full_output.paper_title: ZAM-CS, a novel chimeric endolysin with enhanced stability and rapid action against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.
full_output.key_findings: The study describes the engineering and assessment of a novel chimeric endolysin, ZAM-CS, which combines the catalytic domain of SAL-1 endolysin with the peptidoglycan-binding domain of lysostaphin. ZAM-CS demonstrated high stability, rapid bactericidal activity, and effectiveness against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) and other Gram-positive bacteria.
full_output.methodology: The study involved in silico modeling, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, cloning, expression, purification, and activity assays of ZAM-CS.

full_output.paper_title: Serotype distribution, virulence factors, and antimicrobial resistance profiles of Streptococcus agalactiae (Group B Streptococcus) isolated from pregnant women in the Brazilian Amazon.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified the presence of erm(A), erm(B), and mef(A/E) genes in Streptococcus agalactiae isolates from pregnant women in the Brazilian Amazon, indicating resistance to macrolides and lincosamides. Tetracycline resistance was prevalent, while all isolates were susceptible to β-lactam antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: The study used PCR for detection of virulence and resistance genes, antimicrobial susceptibility testing via disk diffusion, and capsular typing.

full_output.paper_title: Local Genomic Epidemiology of Acinetobacter baumannii Circulating in Hospital and Non-hospital Environments in Kano, Northwest Nigeria.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies various AMR genes in Acinetobacter baumannii isolates from hospital and non-hospital environments in Kano, Nigeria, including bla OXA-66, bla OXA-180, bla ADC-25, aadA1, aph(3')-Ia, aph(3'' )-Ib, aac(3)-Ia, aph(6)-Id, tetB, sul1, and sul2, which confer resistance to beta-lactams, aminoglycosides, tetracyclines, and sulfonamides.
full_output.methodology: Whole genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis were used to identify AMR genes in A. baumannii isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Susceptibility toward cefiderocol and sulbactam-durlobactam in extensively drug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii detected from ICU admission screening in Hanoi, Vietnam, 2023.

full_output.paper_title: Whole genome analysis reveals the distribution and diversity of plasmid reservoirs of NDM and MCR in commercial chicken farms in China.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the widespread presence of bla NDM-5 and mcr genes in multidrug-resistant gram-negative bacteria isolated from commercial chicken farms in China, highlighting the role of plasmids in the dissemination of these resistance determinants.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis were used to identify and characterize the resistance genes and plasmid types in the isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Polyethylene terephthalate (PET) primary degradation products affect c-di-GMP-, cAMP-signaling, and quorum sensing (QS) in Vibrio gazogenes DSM 21264.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies the PET hydrolase PET6 and the metallo-β-lactamase UlaG as key players in the metabolism of BHET, a primary degradation product of PET, in Vibrio gazogenes DSM 21264.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptome analysis, enzyme activity assays, and heterologous expression in E. coli.

full_output.paper_title: Impact of antibiotics on membrane vesicle production in Group B Streptococcus.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that antibiotics increase membrane vesicle (MV) production in Group B Streptococcus (GBS) and alter their protein composition, potentially aiding bacterial survival under antibiotic stress.
full_output.methodology: The study used nanoparticle tracking analysis, microscopy, and proteomics to analyze MV production and composition in GBS following antibiotic exposure.

full_output.paper_title: Synthesis and Characterization of Co(II), Cu(II), and Ni(II) Complexes of 2,2'-Bipyridine-4,4'-Dicarboxamide Ligands: Antibacterial Evaluation Against Resistant Bacteria and Enzyme Inhibition.
full_output.key_findings: The study reports the synthesis and characterization of Co(II), Cu(II), and Ni(II) complexes of 2,2'-bipyridine-4,4'-dicarboxamide ligands. Among these, the L2-Co complex showed strong antibacterial activity against Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa, while the L2-Ni complex displayed the most potent enzyme inhibition with IC50 values of 1.35 μM for lipase, 4.33 μM for acetylcholinesterase, and 6.42 μM for butyrylcholinesterase.
full_output.methodology: The study involved the synthesis and characterization of ligands and their metal complexes using various analytical techniques, followed by in vitro antibacterial and enzyme inhibition assays.

full_output.paper_title: Inhibitors of the Bacterioferritin Ferredoxin Complex Dysregulate Iron Homeostasis and Kill Acinetobacter baumannii and Biofilm-Embedded Pseudomonas aeruginosa Cells.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies 4-aminoisoindoline-1,3-dione derivatives as inhibitors of the Bfr-Bfd complex, disrupting iron homeostasis and demonstrating bactericidal effects against Acinetobacter baumannii and Pseudomonas aeruginosa biofilms.
full_output.methodology: The study employed structural analysis, MIC testing, time-kill assays, and siderophore production measurements to evaluate the antimicrobial activity of 4-aminoisoindoline-1,3-dione derivatives.

full_output.paper_title: Streptococcus pneumoniae carriage, antimicrobial resistance, and serotype distribution in children and adults from Paraguay in the post-vaccinal era.
full_output.key_findings: The study found that antibiotic resistance to beta-lactams and macrolides has increased in Streptococcus pneumoniae isolates, with nearly one-third of the isolates being multidrug resistant. Multi-drug resistant pediatric isolates were predominantly associated with serotypes 19F and 19A.
full_output.methodology: Antibiotic susceptibility testing was performed using the Vitek2 system, and serotyping was done via multiplex real-time PCR.

full_output.key_findings: The study investigated the effects of silver nitrate on Mycobacterium abscessus biofilms in a simulated antimicrobial showerhead environment. It found that high silver concentrations reduced biofilm cell densities but did not fully inactivate M. abscessus. Transcriptomic analysis showed upregulation of genes related to stress survival, including those involved in flavoprotein, chaperone, and protease synthesis, ribosome synthesis, and cysteine and methionine metabolism under lower silver doses, and peptidoglycan synthesis and antioxidant production under higher silver doses.
full_output.methodology: The study used CDC biofilm reactors to simulate a showerhead environment, assessed biofilm density, silver accumulation, morphology, and gene expression through transcriptomics, and performed statistical analysis to compare outcomes across different silver concentrations.

full_output.paper_title: Correlation Between the Distribution of Virulence Genes and Drug Resistance Genes and Clinical Characteristics of Lower Respiratory Tract Infections with Acinetobacter baumannii and Klebsiella pneumoniae.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified several virulence and resistance genes associated with Acinetobacter baumannii (AB) and Klebsiella pneumoniae (KP) in lower respiratory tract infections. For AB, the highest detection rates of virulence genes were adeG and adeF (62.5%), followed by lpxD (56.25%). For KP, the highest detection rate was ybtE (54.55%). full_output.paper_title: Phage steering in the presence of a competing bacterial pathogen.

full_output.key_findings: The study identifies carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (CRE), extended-spectrum beta-lactamases (ESBLs)-producing bacteria, carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii (CRAB), and carbapenem-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa (CRPA) as significant causes of post-liver transplant infections. It highlights the increasing prevalence of drug-resistant pathogens, especially carbapenem-resistant gram-negative bacteria.

full_output.paper_title: Repurposing a drug to punish carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii.

Fendiline targets the LolF protein, disrupting lipoprotein trafficking and leading to increased lethality in OXA-23-overexpressing cells.

full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing, PCR, and bioinformatics analysis were used to characterize the genetic features of the plasmid and its resistance genes.

full_output.paper_title: Prevalence and emm typing of multi-drug resistant Streptococcus pyogenes in tertiary care health settings.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified emm 12, emm 4, and emm 1 as the most prevalent emm types among S. pyogenes isolates in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. High resistance to erythromycin and tetracycline was observed, while no resistance to vancomycin and teicoplanin was recorded.

full_output.paper_title: An Engineered Prodrug Selectively Suppresses β-Lactam-Resistant Bacteria in a Mixed Microbial Setting.
full_output.key_findings: The study presents AcephPT, a prodrug that selectively suppresses β-lactam-resistant bacteria by exploiting β-lactamase activity. AcephPT is hydrolytically activated exclusively by ESBL-producing bacteria, releasing pyrithione, which acts as an antimicrobial agent. This prodrug effectively targets ESBL-producing strains while sparing non-producing bacteria, demonstrating potential for combating β-lactam resistance.
full_output.methodology: The study utilized phenotypic screens, NMR spectroscopy, and bacterial growth assays to evaluate the activity and selectivity of AcephPT against various β-lactamase-producing and non-producing bacterial strains.

full_output.paper_title: Enhanced laboratory surveillance study of Campylobacter species in England.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified mutations in gyrA, tet(O), aadK, and 23S rRNA that confer resistance to ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, streptomycin, and erythromycin in Campylobacter isolates.

full_output.paper_title: Proactive Resistance Management Studies Highlight the Role of Cytochrome P450 Genes in the Resistance of Tuta absoluta Against Tetraniliprole.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies CYP405D1, CYP6AB269, and CYP4AU1 as cytochrome P450 genes contributing to tetraniliprole resistance in Tuta absoluta through overexpression and functional validation via RNAi.
full_output.methodology: RNA-seq, RT-qPCR, and nanocarrier-mediated RNAi were used to analyze gene expression and validate the role of P450 genes in tetraniliprole resistance.
full_output.sample_size: Multiple biological replicates for each gene and treatment

full_output.paper_title: Antibacterial and Anti-Biofilm Activities of Alpha-Mangostin: Mechanisms and Applications
full_output.key_findings: Alpha-mangostin exhibits antibacterial and anti-biofilm activities by disrupting bacterial membranes, inhibiting key enzymes, and downregulating genes involved in biofilm formation and efflux pump activity.
full_output.methodology: The study analyzed the effects of alpha-mangostin on bacterial growth, biofilm formation, and gene expression using microbiological assays, gene expression profiling, and imaging techniques.

full_output.paper_title: Rose Bengal Conjugated to Lectins for Targeted Antibacterial Photodynamic Treatment.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that ConA-RB and WGA-RB conjugates effectively eradicate both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria, including multidrug-resistant strains, under photodynamic treatment.
full_output.methodology: The study used spectroscopy, microscopy, and photodynamic assays to evaluate the antibacterial activity of RB conjugated with ConA and WGA.

full_output.paper_title: Bactericidal Effect of Synthetic Phenylalkylamides Inspired by Gibbilimbol B Against Neisseria gonorrhoeae.
full_output.key_findings: The study evaluated synthetic phenylalkylamides inspired by gibbilimbol B for their antibacterial activity against Neisseria gonorrhoeae, demonstrating that compound 8 showed improved bactericidal activity compared to the natural product.
full_output.methodology: The study synthesized and evaluated the antibacterial activity of eight amides against N. gonorrhoeae using in vitro minimum bactericidal activity (MBC) assays.

full_output.paper_title: Functionalization of Stainless Steel with Hyperbranched Poly(viologen) Brushes for Enhanced Antimicrobial, Antifouling and Anticorrosion.
full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that quaternized viologen-functionalized stainless steel surfaces exhibit superior antimicrobial, antifouling, and anticorrosion properties, effectively inhibiting the adhesion and settlement of various marine microorganisms and barnacle cyprids.
full_output.methodology: Surface functionalization techniques including XPS, fluorescence microscopy, and electrochemical studies were used to evaluate the antimicrobial and antifouling properties of the modified surfaces.

full_output.paper_title: Cefiderocol "under siege"? Understanding the rise of NDM-mediated resistance to novel agents.

blaNDM-5.evidence_note: The paper states that NDM-1 and NDM-5 are able to inactivate cefiderocol (FDC), while VIM-2 and IMP-1 show impaired catalytic efficiency against this substrate.

full_output.key_findings: The study demonstrates that NDM-1 and NDM-5 efficiently hydrolyze cefiderocol (FDC), while VIM-2 and IMP-1 show impaired catalytic efficiency against this substrate. All MBL enzymes form a reversible enzyme-product adduct with FDC, but NDM variants are poorly inhibited, leading to efficient turnover rates.
full_output.methodology: Steady-state kinetic measurements, NMR spectroscopy, ESI-MS, and pre-steady state kinetics were used to analyze the hydrolysis of FDC by various MBLs.

full_output.paper_title: Beyond patient contact: combined short- and long read sequencing reveals continuous occurrence of genomically related carbapenemase-producing Enterobacterales and plasmid mobility in a hospital, Germany, 2018 to 2021.
full_output.key_findings: The study identified blaVIM-1, blaOXA-1, blaOXA-10, and blaOXA-162 as carbapenemase genes in hospital-acquired Enterobacterales. Additionally, plasmids carrying resistance genes such as sul1, qnrS1, aadA1p.m., SHV-12, and OXA-10 were found to facilitate multidrug resistance.
full_output.methodology: Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) using both short- and long-read technologies was employed to analyze the genomic relatedness and plasmid mobility of carbapenemase-producing Enterobacterales (CPE) in a hospital setting.

full_output.paper_title: Mutation of an active site-adjacent residue in VIM indirectly dictates interactions with and blunts inhibition by D-captopril.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies mutations in VIM enzymes that affect their interaction with D-captopril, highlighting the importance of active site-adjacent residues in inhibitor binding and efficacy.
full_output.methodology: Structural analysis and enzymatic assays were used to investigate the effects of mutations on VIM enzyme inhibition by D-captopril.

full_output.paper_title: Emergency and persistence of Escherichia coli ST131 as community-onset antimicrobial resistant urinary tract infection in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies various CTX-M-type beta-lactamase genes, including bla CTX-M-15, bla CTX-M-27, bla CTX-M-8, bla CTX-M-2, bla CTX-M-14, bla CTX-M-55, and bla CTX-M-238, as prevalent in ESBL-producing E. coli isolates from Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. These genes are associated with resistance to multiple beta-lactam antibiotics.

full_output.paper_title: Effect of luteolin on ceftiofur intestinal absorption: the rational use of Caco-2 monolayer cell model and everted gut sac model.
full_output.key_findings: Luteolin increases ceftiofur intestinal absorption by downregulating MRP2 and tight junction proteins (Occludin, Claudin-1, and ZO-1).

full_output.paper_title: Diverse Genetic Mechanisms Enable Pseudomonas syringae to Rapidly Overcome Effector-Triggered Immunity.

full_output.paper_title: Microbial community structure and resistome dynamics on elevator buttons in response to surface disinfection practices.

full_output.paper_title: Clinical characteristics, risk factors and prognosis of Klebsiella pneumoniae infection in patients with different states of immune function: a retrospective study.
full_output.key_findings: The study highlights the clinical characteristics, risk factors, and prognosis of Klebsiella pneumoniae (KP) infections in immunocompromised versus immunocompetent patients, emphasizing the higher mortality rates and challenges in managing multidrug-resistant KP strains.
full_output.methodology: Retrospective study analyzing clinical data, microbiological characteristics, and treatment outcomes of KP infections in hospitalized patients.

full_output.paper_title: Heterogeneous subpopulations in Escherichia coli strains acquire adaptive resistance to imipenem treatment through rapid transcriptional regulation.
full_output.key_findings: The study identifies that heterogeneous subpopulations in Escherichia coli can acquire adaptive resistance to imipenem through rapid transcriptional regulation, with enhanced expression of genes involved in exopolysaccharide and peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
full_output.methodology: Transcriptome analysis and molecular biology experiments were used to investigate the role of non-genetically encoded mechanisms in the development of heteroresistance.

full_output.paper_title: Towards the development of supramolecular self-associating amphiphiles as antibiofilm agents against Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Candida albicans biofilms.

full_output.paper_title: Lipoic Acid Based Redox-Responsive Degradable Antimicrobial Polymers.

full_output.paper_title: The RNF/NQR redox pumps: a versatile system for energy transduction in bacteria and archaea.
full_output.key_findings: The paper discusses the RNF/NQR redox pumps, focusing on their structure, function, and role in energy conservation in various bacteria and archaea. It highlights the importance of these complexes in metabolic processes and their potential as targets for new antibiotics.
full_output.methodology: Structural and functional analyses of RNF and NQR complexes from various organisms, including biochemical and physiological experiments.

full_output.paper_title: Identification of ESBL-Producing Enterobacterales From Vegetable Plants: Preliminary Findings From a Small Cross-Sectional Study in a Rural Area of Madagascar.

full_output.methodology: Meta-analysis of 196 studies on ESBL-producing E. coli in sub-Saharan Africa, using genomic testing to identify resistance genes.

full_output.paper_title: High sensitivity and enhanced antibiotic stewardship of the BioFire Joint Infection Panel in acute, but not chronic, prosthetic joint infection of the knee.

full_output.paper_title: Population pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic modeling to optimize aztreonam-avibactam dose regimens for adult patients.

full_output.paper_title: Genomics to understand the global landscape of linezolid resistance in Enterococcus faecium and Enterococcus faecalis.

full_output.paper_title: Efficacy and mechanism of action of cipargamin as an antibabesial drug candidate.

full_output.paper_title: Tolerance to Herbicides and Resistance to Antibacterial Drugs of Bacterial Isolates From the Guarani Aquifer System (Brazil).

full_output.paper_title: Intelligent ROS therapy driven by iron-based nanozyme with controllable catalytic activity for infected wound healing.

full_output.methodology: The study evaluates the catalytic activity and antibacterial efficacy of FeNZ through in vitro and in vivo experiments, including ROS generation assays, bacterial membrane disruption analysis, and wound healing assessment in a murine model.

full_output.paper_title: Detection assay of polymyxin resistance coding mcr-1 gene based on CRISPR/Cas13a system.

full_output.methodology: CRISPR-ERASE assay combined with lateral flow strips for visual detection of the mcr-1 gene, validated by qPCR.

full_output.paper_title: Collateral sensitivity and cross-resistance in six species of bacteria exposed to six classes of antibiotics.

full_output.paper_title: VLX600, an anticancer iron chelator, exerts antimicrobial effects on Mycobacterium abscessus infections.

full_output.paper_title: Nano formulation development and antibacterial activity of cinnamon bark extract-chitosan composites against Burkholderia Glumae the causative agent of Bacterial Panicle Blight in rice.

full_output.methodology: The study evaluated the antibacterial activity of CBE-CS through in vitro experiments, including zone of inhibition, MIC, and MBC assays, and assessed its efficacy in greenhouse trials.

full_output.paper_title: Unveiling the structure, function and dynamics of StmPr1 in Stenotrophomonas maltophilia virulence.

full_output.key_findings: Bifidobacterium bifidum G9-1 (BBG9-1) was found to be susceptible to several antimicrobials in vitro, but its viability was significantly higher in the presence of fecal suspensions, indicating that the intestinal microbiota may protect it from antimicrobial effects.
